import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';
const NotificationContext = createContext(null);

export function NotificationProvider({ children }) {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([
    { id: 1, text: "Budget ceiling limit updated for CAS.", type: "warning" },
    { id: 2, text: "Proposal for Heavy Duty Printer approved.", type: "success" }
  ]);

  const addNotification = (text, type = "info") => {
    setNotifications(prev => [{ id: Date.now(), text, type }, ...prev]);
  };

  return (
    <NotificationContext.Provider value={{ notifications, addNotification }}>
      {children}
    </NotificationContext.Provider>
  );
}
export const useNotifications = () => useContext(NotificationContext);

// frontend/src/views/admin/Analytics/ComplianceAnalytics.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck, RefreshCw, BarChart2, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";

export default function ComplianceAnalytics() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchAnalytics = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/department-analytics`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch compliance analytics data.");
      setAnalytics(await res.json());
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchAnalytics();
    }
  }, [token]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <BarChart2 className="text-purple-400 w-5 h-5" />
            <span>Compliance Analytics & Abuse Index</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Real-time tracking of non-standard requests. Identifies departments exceeding the 20% limit for custom "Other" selections.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchAnalytics}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 px-3.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Diagnostics</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/30 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Analytics Listing Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="col-span-2 text-center py-20 text-slate-500">
            <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
            <span>Compiling compliance metrics...</span>
          </div>
        ) : analytics.length > 0 ? (
          analytics.map((dept) => {
            const hasAbuse = dept.requires_review_abuse;
            return (
              <div 
                key={dept.department_id} 
                className={`p-6 rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                  hasAbuse 
                    ? "bg-red-955/10 border-red-900/40" 
                    : "bg-slate-900 border-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-200">{dept.department_name}</h3>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">ID: {dept.department_id}</p>
                  </div>
                  {hasAbuse ? (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded">
                      <ShieldAlert className="w-3 h-3" /> Flagged (Abuse)
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded">
                      <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> Compliant
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 pt-4 font-mono">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Total Items</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300 font-bold text-sm">{dept.total_proposals}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Custom Items</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300 font-bold text-sm">{dept.custom_proposals}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Other %</span>
                    <span className={`font-bold text-sm ${hasAbuse ? "text-red-400" : "text-emerald-400"}`}>
                      {dept.custom_ratio_percent}%
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/50 flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 font-semibold">Missing Canvas Uploads:</span>
                  <span className={`font-bold ${dept.missing_canvas_count > 0 ? "text-red-400" : "text-slate-400"}`}>
                    {dept.missing_canvas_count} items
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="col-span-2 text-center py-20 text-slate-500">
            No compliance analytics profiles mapped.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Audit/AuditTrails.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { History, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Search } from "lucide-react";

export default function AuditTrails() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchLogs = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/audit-logs`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load audit logs from the security ledger.");
      setLogs(await res.json());
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchLogs();
    }
  }, [token]);

  const filteredLogs = logs.filter(log => {
    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    const action = (log.action || "").toLowerCase();
    const proposalId = (log.proposal_id || "").toLowerCase();
    const subscriptionId = (log.subscription_id || "").toLowerCase();
    
    return action.includes(term) || proposalId.includes(term) || subscriptionId.includes(term);
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <History className="text-yellow-400 w-5 h-5" />
            <span>COA Immutable Audit Security Trails</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Tamper-proof transactional security ledger. Captures system changes, price modifications, and state adjustments.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchLogs}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 px-3.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Refresh Ledger</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/4 border border-red-900/30 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex bg-slate-900 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 items-center gap-2.5 max-w-md">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search by Action or Document ID..."
          className="w-full bg-transparent outline-none border-none text-xs text-white"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Ledger Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500 mb-2" />
              <span>Querying transaction records...</span>
            </div>
          ) : filteredLogs.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-[10px] font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase">
                  <th className="p-3.5">Timestamp</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Target ID</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Action Type</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Operator ID</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Old Value</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">New Value</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850 text-slate-300">
                {filteredLogs.map((log) => (
                  <tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/20 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                      {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-blue-400 select-all font-bold">
                      {log.proposal_id || log.subscription_id || "SYSTEM"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-200">
                      {log.action}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-400">
                      User: {log.user_id}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-red-400 max-w-[200px] truncate select-all">
                      {JSON.stringify(log.old_value)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-emerald-400 max-w-[200px] truncate select-all">
                      {JSON.stringify(log.new_value)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500">
              No matching security ledger records found.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\admin\Budget\CeilingControl.jsx
=========================================

// frontend/src/views/admin/Budget/CeilingControl.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { getBudgetCeilings, updateBudgetCeiling } from "../../../api/admin";
import { 
  TrendingUp, ShieldCheck, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, 
  Landmark, ShieldAlert, Award, Edit2, Settings 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function CeilingControl() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  const [ceilings, setCeilings] = useState([]);
  const [globalCeiling, setGlobalCeiling] = useState("200000000.00");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Pre-flight Dry Run state
  const [validationResult, setValidationResult] = useState(null);

  // Edit Modal State
  const [activeDept, setActiveDept] = useState(null);
  const [subCeilingInput, setSubCeilingInput] = useState("");
  const [capexInput, setCapexInput] = useState("");
  const [mooeInput, setMooeInput] = useState("");
  const [useDefaultSplit, setUseDefaultSplit] = useState(true);

  // Robust backend host URL fallback
  const rawRoot = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawRoot.endsWith("/") ? rawRoot.slice(0, -1) : rawRoot;
  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken;

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getBudgetCeilings(token);
      setCeilings(data);
      if (data.length > 0) {
        setGlobalCeiling(String(data[0].global_ceiling || "200000000.00"));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  // Update overall institutional budget cap
  const handleUpdateGlobalCeiling = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/global-budget-ceiling`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          global_ceiling: parseFloat(globalCeiling) || 0.0
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to update global ceiling limit.");
      }

      setSuccess("Institutional Global Budget Ceiling updated successfully.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Run Pre-flight Budget Dry-Run Validation Check
  const runValidationCheck = async () => {
    setValidating(true);
    setError(null);
    setValidationResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/budget-validation`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Pre-flight validation check failed to complete.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      setValidationResult(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  };

  const openEditModal = (dept) => {
    setActiveDept(dept);
    const subCeil = dept.sub_ceiling || 0;
    const cap = dept.allocated_capex || 0;
    const mooe = dept.allocated_mooe || 0;

    setSubCeilingInput(String(subCeil));
    setCapexInput(String(cap));
    setMooeInput(String(mooe));

    // Determine if the existing budget matches the 70/30 split rule
    const expectedCap = Math.round(subCeil * 0.70);
    const isDefaultSplit = (cap === expectedCap) && (mooe === subCeil - expectedCap);
    setUseDefaultSplit(isDefaultSplit);
  };

  const handleSaveDepartmentCeiling = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    let capexVal = parseFloat(capexInput) || 0.0;
    let mooeVal = parseFloat(mooeInput) || 0.0;
    const subCeilingVal = parseFloat(subCeilingInput) || 0.0;

    // Apply the standard 70/30 CapEx/MOOE split if selected
    if (useDefaultSplit) {
      capexVal = Math.round(subCeilingVal * 0.70);
      mooeVal = subCeilingVal - capexVal;
    }

    try {
      await updateBudgetCeiling(token, {
        department_id: activeDept.department_id,
        allocated_capex: capexVal,
        allocated_mooe: mooeVal,
        sub_ceiling: subCeilingVal
      });

      setSuccess(`Budget allocation updated for '${activeDept.department_name}'.`);
      setActiveDept(null);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Landmark className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
            <span>Sub-Ceiling Allocation Monitor</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Enforce spending limits and balance allocations between Capital Outlay (CapEx) and MOOE budgets for the cycle.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={runValidationCheck}
            disabled={validating}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ShieldCheck className={`w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 ${validating ? "animate-pulse" : ""}`} />
            <span>Pre-flight Dry Run Check</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={fetchData}
            disabled={loading}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-850 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Real-time Dry Run validation banners */}
      {validationResult && (
        <div className={`p-5 border rounded-xl flex items-start gap-4 leading-relaxed ${
          validationResult.validation_passed 
            ? "bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-800/80 text-emerald-300"
            : "bg-red-955/20 border-red-900/80 text-red-300"
        }`}>
          {validationResult.validation_passed ? (
            <>
              <Award className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">Dry Run Validation Successful</h4>
                <p className="mt-1 text-slate-400">
                  Consolidated departmental spending is completely balanced and cleared. Your figures fall within the active sub-ceilings.
                </p>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ShieldAlert className="w-6 h-6 text-red-400 shrink-0 animate-bounce" />
              <div className="space-y-2 flex-grow">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">Budget Ceiling Overage Detected</h4>
                <p className="text-slate-400">
                  The following departments have exceeded their allocated CapEx or MOOE limits. These overages must be adjusted before document compilation:
                </p>
                <div className="space-y-1 bg-slate-950/50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-red-900/40 max-w-xl font-mono">
                  {validationResult.breaches?.map((b, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between gap-4 text-xs">
                      <span>{b.department_name}</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-red-400">
                        Overage: +₱{Number(b.budget_overage_php || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Left Form Panel: Global Cap Settings */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 h-fit space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
            <span>Global Ceiling Settings</span>
          </h3>

          <form onSubmit={handleUpdateGlobalCeiling} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Global Institutional Budget Cap (PHP)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                required
                value={globalCeiling}
                onChange={(e) => setGlobalCeiling(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-600 transition-all text-xs"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Updating..." : "Save Global Limit"}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Right Dashboard Board: Department sub-ceilings and progress meters */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-5">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            Active Cycle Department Allocations
          </h3>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-2 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-purple-500" />
              <span>Fetching departmental profiles...</span>
            </div>
          ) : ceilings.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              {ceilings.map((dept) => {
                const totalSpent = Number(dept.current_spent || 0);
                const subCeiling = Number(dept.sub_ceiling || 0);
                const capexAllocated = Number(dept.allocated_capex || 0);
                const mooeAllocated = Number(dept.allocated_mooe || 0);

                const subCeilingSpentPercent = subCeiling > 0 ? Math.min((totalSpent / subCeiling) * 100, 100) : 0;
                
                return (
                  <div key={dept.department_id} className="p-4 bg-slate-955/40 rounded-xl border border-slate-850 space-y-3.5 hover:border-slate-800 transition-all">
                    {/* Department Header */}
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm">{dept.department_name}</h4>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">ID mapping: {dept.department_id}</p>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => openEditModal(dept)}
                        className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-purple-400 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        title="Configure Allotments"
                      >
                        <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* Allotment stats grid */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 border-t border-slate-900 pt-3">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Consolidated Cap</span>
                        <div className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-300 text-xs mt-0.5">
                          ₱{subCeiling.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">CapEx / Hardware Cap</span>
                        <div className="font-mono text-slate-400 text-xs mt-0.5">
                          ₱{capexAllocated.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">MOOE / Software Cap</span>
                        <div className="font-mono text-slate-400 text-xs mt-0.5">
                          ₱{mooeAllocated.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Progress tracking bar */}
                    <div className="space-y-1 pt-1.5">
                      <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px]">
                        <span className="text-slate-500">Utilization Rate</span>
                        <span className={`font-bold ${totalSpent > subCeiling ? "text-red-400" : "text-slate-300"}`}>
                          ₱{totalSpent.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ({subCeilingSpentPercent.toFixed(1)}%)
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-850">
                        <div 
                          className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${
                            totalSpent > subCeiling ? "bg-red-500 animate-pulse" : "bg-purple-500"
                          }`}
                          style={{ width: `${subCeilingSpentPercent}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500">
              No departmental sub-ceilings configured for this cycle. Set up allocations using the tools.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Edit Department Allocation Modal */}
      {activeDept && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto max-h-[90vh]">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Adjust Department Allocations</h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setActiveDept(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-lg cursor-pointer"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveDepartmentCeiling} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-955 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 space-y-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Department</span>
                <p className="font-bold text-slate-200">{activeDept.department_name}</p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Consolidated Sub-Ceiling Limit (PHP)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  required
                  disabled={!useDefaultSplit}
                  value={subCeilingInput}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const total = parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0;
                    setSubCeilingInput(e.target.value);
                    if (useDefaultSplit) {
                      const cap = Math.round(total * 0.70);
                      setCapexInput(String(cap));
                      setMooeInput(String(total - cap));
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className={`w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none ${
                    !useDefaultSplit ? "opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed" : ""
                  }`}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-955/50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-850/80">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  id="split_toggle"
                  checked={useDefaultSplit}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const checked = e.target.checked;
                    setUseDefaultSplit(checked);
                    if (checked) {
                      const total = parseFloat(subCeilingInput) || 0;
                      const cap = Math.round(total * 0.70);
                      setCapexInput(String(cap));
                      setMooeInput(String(total - cap));
                    }
                  }}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                />
                <label htmlFor="split_toggle" className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-300 cursor-pointer select-none">
                  Apply Standard 70/30 CapEx/MOOE split automatically
                </label>
              </div>

              {!useDefaultSplit && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 animate-fadeIn">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      Manual CapEx / Hardware Allotment (PHP)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      required
                      value={capexInput}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const cap = parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0;
                        setCapexInput(e.target.value);
                        setSubCeilingInput(String(cap + (parseFloat(mooeInput) || 0)));
                      }}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      Manual MOOE / Software Allotment (PHP)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      required
                      value={mooeInput}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const mooe = parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0;
                        setMooeInput(e.target.value);
                        setSubCeilingInput(String((parseFloat(capexInput) || 0) + mooe));
                      }}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all mt-4 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>{submitting ? "Updating Allocations..." : "Save Allotments"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Campus/CampusManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { 
  getCampuses, 
  createCampus, 
  updateCampus, 
  deleteCampus 
} from "../../../api/admin";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { 
  Landmark, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Edit3, 
  Save, 
  X, 
  RefreshCw, 
  MapPin, 
  Hash, 
  AlertCircle 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function CampusManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [campuses, setCampuses] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  
  // Form States
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", location: "", code: "" });
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ name: "", location: "", code: "" });

  const fetchCampuses = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getCampuses(user.token);
      setCampuses(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load campuses.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchCampuses();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: form.name.trim(),
        location: form.location.trim(),
        code: form.code.trim().toUpperCase()
      };
      await createCampus(user.token, payload);
      setForm({ name: "", location: "", code: "" });
      await fetchCampuses();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to create campus registration.");
    }
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (campus) => {
    setEditingId(campus.id);
    setEditForm({
      name: campus.name,
      location: campus.location,
      code: campus.code
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setEditForm({ name: "", location: "", code: "" });
  };

  const handleUpdate = async (e, id) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: editForm.name.trim(),
        location: editForm.location.trim(),
        code: editForm.code.trim().toUpperCase()
      };
      await updateCampus(user.token, id, payload);
      setEditingId(null);
      await fetchCampuses();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update campus configuration.");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this campus? This may impact linked departments and user records.")) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      await deleteCampus(user.token, id);
      await fetchCampuses();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete campus registration.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-6xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Landmark className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Campus Configuration Registry</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Configure SUC campuses and planning parameters (Table B-1 requirement).
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchCampuses}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Refresh Data</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900/50 text-red-400 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Creation Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
            Register New Campus
          </h3>
          
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Campus Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. CSPC Buhi Campus"
              value={form.name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Physical Location</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <MapPin className="absolute left-3 top-3 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. Buhi, Camarines Sur"
                value={form.location}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, location: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full p-2.5 pl-9 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Campus Code</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Hash className="absolute left-3 top-3 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. BUHI"
                value={form.code}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, code: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full p-2.5 pl-9 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none"
                maxLength={10}
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button 
            type="submit" 
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> 
            <span>Add Campus Unit</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Data Table Panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800 pb-2 mb-4">
            Physical Campus Registries
          </h3>
          
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading && campuses.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Syncing registries...</span>
              </div>
            ) : campuses.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 w-1/4">Code</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 w-1/3">Campus Name</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 w-1/3">Location</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/40">
                  {campuses.map(c => (
                    <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/25 transition-colors">
                      {editingId === c.id ? (
                        /* Editing Form Row */
                        <td colSpan={4} className="py-3 px-2">
                          <form onSubmit={(e) => handleUpdate(e, c.id)} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 items-center">
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={editForm.code}
                              onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, code: e.target.value })}
                              className="p-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white font-mono"
                              required
                            />
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={editForm.name}
                              onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, name: e.target.value })}
                              className="p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white col-span-1"
                              required
                            />
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={editForm.location}
                              onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, location: e.target.value })}
                              className="p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white col-span-1"
                              required
                            />
                            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                              <button 
                                type="submit" 
                                className="p-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Save changes"
                              >
                                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button 
                                type="button" 
                                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                                className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Cancel modification"
                              >
                                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </form>
                        </td>
                      ) : (
                        /* Standard Row */
                        <>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono text-blue-400 font-bold">{c.code}</td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 font-medium text-slate-200">{c.name}</td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 text-slate-400">{c.location}</td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleStartEdit(c)}
                                className="p-1.5 hover:text-blue-400 text-slate-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Edit properties"
                              >
                                <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)}
                                className="p-1.5 hover:text-red-400 text-slate-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Purge campus registration"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500 italic">
                No campuses configured. Register your physical campuses using the form.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Catalog/CatalogManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { Plus, Settings2, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Package, ToggleLeft, ToggleRight, FileSearch } from "lucide-react";

export default function CatalogManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [approvedProposals, setApprovedProposals] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Form states matching CatalogItem schemas
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    item_key: "",
    display_name: "",
    standard_unit_cost: "",
    category: "computing_devices",
    allowed_offices: "",
    supplier_name: "",
    canvas_evidence_url: ""
  });

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken;

  const fetchCatalog = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/catalog`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setItems(data);
      } else {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Could not retrieve the dynamic catalog list.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchApprovedProposals = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/approved-canvas`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setApprovedProposals(await res.json());
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Failed to load approved references dropdown: ", e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchCatalog();
      fetchApprovedProposals();
    }
  }, [token]);

  const handleReferenceSelect = (e) => {
    const refId = e.target.value;
    if (!refId) return;

    const selected = approvedProposals.find(item => item.id === refId);
    if (selected) {
      // Auto-fill form fields with database parameters from chosen reference
      setForm({
        ...form,
        item_key: selected.display_name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, "_"),
        display_name: selected.display_name,
        standard_unit_cost: String(selected.unit_cost),
        category: selected.type === "CapEx" ? "computing_devices" : "software",
        supplier_name: selected.supplier_name,
        canvas_evidence_url: selected.canvas_evidence_url
      });
      setSuccess(`Referenced approved request fields compiled dynamically.`);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (form.item_key.trim().toLowerCase() === "other") {
      setError("Registration Error: 'other' is a reserved system keyword and cannot be used as an item key.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const parsedOffices = form.allowed_offices
      ? form.allowed_offices.split(",").map((o) => o.trim()).filter((o) => o.length > 0)
      : [];

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/catalog`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          item_key: form.item_key.trim(),
          display_name: form.display_name.trim(),
          standard_unit_cost: parseFloat(form.standard_unit_cost) || 0.0,
          category: form.category,
          allowed_offices: parsedOffices,
          supplier_name: form.supplier_name.trim() || null,
          canvas_evidence_url: form.canvas_evidence_url.trim() || null,
          is_active: true
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to register standard catalog item.");
      }

      setSuccess(`Catalog item '${form.display_name}' created successfully.`);
      setForm({
        item_key: "",
        display_name: "",
        standard_unit_cost: "",
        category: "computing_devices",
        allowed_offices: "",
        supplier_name: "",
        canvas_evidence_url: ""
      });
      fetchCatalog();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleItemState = async (item) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/catalog/${item.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          is_active: !item.is_active
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to transition catalog item state.");
      }

      setSuccess(`State transition successful for item '${item.display_name}'.`);
      fetchCatalog();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto text-xs">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Standard Pricing Reference Catalog Manager</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Establish pricing limits and standard specifications. Populate catalog items directly from approved custom requests.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchCatalog}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Refresh List</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Creator Form Sidebar */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 h-fit space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Add Catalog Reference</span>
          </h3>

          {/* Reference approved proposals dropdown */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5 p-3 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg">
            <label className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              <FileSearch className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
              <span>Reference Approved Custom Request</span>
            </label>
            <select
              onChange={handleReferenceSelect}
              className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-200 outline-none text-xs"
            >
              <option value="">-- Click to select reference --</option>
              {approvedProposals.map((ref) => (
                <option key={ref.id} value={ref.id}>
                  [{ref.type}] {ref.display_name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Catalog Item Identifier Key (Unique, Lowercase)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={form.item_key}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, item_key: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g. tablet_standard_v2"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Display Name (Procurement Reference Label)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={form.display_name}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, display_name: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g. Standard Core-i5 Laptop (16GB)"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Standard Unit Price (PHP)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  min="0.01"
                  required
                  value={form.standard_unit_cost}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, standard_unit_cost: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none font-mono"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Category Type
                </label>
                <select
                  value={form.category}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="computing_devices">Computing Devices</option>
                  <option value="networking">Networking & Connectivity</option>
                  <option value="printers_imaging">Printers & Imaging</option>
                  <option value="software">Software & Licenses</option>
                  <option value="other">Other Operations Items</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Division Access Permissions (Optional, CSV List)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={form.allowed_offices}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, allowed_offices: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="e.g. MIS Department, College of Science"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="border-t border-slate-800/80 pt-3 mt-2 space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Authorized Supplier Reference Name
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.supplier_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, supplier_name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. CSPC Central Procurement"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Canvas Proof S3 URL Link
                </label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={form.canvas_evidence_url}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, canvas_evidence_url: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="https://cspc-compliance.s3.amazonaws.com/..."
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white text-xs outline-none font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Processing..." : "Add Catalog Item"}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Items Listing Board */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase">
              Current Standard Reference Catalog
            </h3>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 font-mono">
              Total Items: {items.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-2 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
                <span className="text-xs">Loading standard references catalog...</span>
              </div>
            ) : items.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Key / Label</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Category</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Standard Unit Cost</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Scope Permissions</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2 text-right">Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800">
                  {items.map((item) => (
                    <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/30 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{item.display_name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5 select-all">{item.item_key}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-slate-400 capitalize">
                        {item.category ? item.category.replace("_", " ") : "N/A"}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 font-mono text-slate-200">
                        ₱{parseFloat(item.standard_unit_cost).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-slate-400">
                        {item.allowed_offices && item.allowed_offices.length > 0 ? (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 max-w-[150px]">
                            {item.allowed_offices.map((office, oIdx) => (
                              <span key={oIdx} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] bg-slate-955 rounded border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[100px]">
                                {office}
                              </span>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-500 italic text-[10px]">Global Access</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => toggleItemState(item)}
                          className="hover:scale-105 transition-transform inline-block cursor-pointer align-middle"
                        >
                          {item.is_active ? (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-400">
                              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">Active</span>
                              <ToggleRight className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-500">
                              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">Disabled</span>
                              <ToggleLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 text-xs">
                The standard reference catalog is currently empty.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Dashboard/Dashboard.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../../context/AuthContext';
import { useCycle } from '../../../context/CycleContext';
import { 
  Inbox, CheckCheck, Landmark, Bolt, Terminal, RefreshCw, 
  Trash2, Lock, Download, ShieldAlert
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function AdminDashboard() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  
  const token = user?.token;
  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;

  const [pendingCount, setPendingCount] = useState(0);
  const [approvedCount, setApprovedCount] = useState(0);
  const [budgetMetrics, setBudgetMetrics] = useState({
    global_ceiling: 200000000.00,
    total_spent: 0.00
  });

  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [generationComplete, setGenerationComplete] = useState(false);
  const [downloadUrl, setDownloadUrl] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [proposals, setProposals] = useState([]);
  
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([
    { time: '01:15:02', text: 'INFO: Standard preambles and instructions locked into task engine.', type: 'text-emerald-400' },
    { time: '01:25:30', text: 'INFO: Budget limits validated for main Nabua and satellite Buhi campus.', type: 'text-blue-400' }
  ]);

  const addLog = (text, type = '') => {
    const now = new Date();
    const timeStr = now.toTimeString().split(' ')[0];
    setLogs(prev => [...prev, { time: timeStr, text, type }]);
  };

  const getDeptName = (id) => {
    const depts = {
      1: "College of Engineering",
      2: "College of Computer Studies",
      3: "College of Arts & Sciences",
      4: "College of Health Sciences",
      5: "College of Tourism",
      6: "Human Resources Management"
    };
    return depts[id] || `Department ${id}`;
  };

  const fetchLiveProposals = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals`, {
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch database queue.");
      const data = await response.json();
      setProposals(data);
      
      setPendingCount(data.filter(p => p.status === 'Submitted').length);
      setApprovedCount(data.filter(p => p.status === 'Approved').length);

      // Fetch consolidated budget metrics
      const metricsResponse = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/dashboard-metrics`, {
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (metricsResponse.ok) {
        const metricsData = await metricsResponse.json();
        setBudgetMetrics({
          global_ceiling: metricsData.global_ceiling || 200000000.00,
          total_spent: metricsData.total_spent || 0.00
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      addLog(`ERROR: Database connection failed. ${err.message}`, 'text-red-400');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchLiveProposals();
    }
  }, [token]);

  const handleApprove = async (id, itemName) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/${id}/approve`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Approval transaction failed.");
      
      setProposals(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: 'Approved' } : p));
      setPendingCount(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
      setApprovedCount(prev => prev + 1);
      
      // Re-trigger metric refresh
      const metricsResponse = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/dashboard-metrics`, {
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (metricsResponse.ok) {
        const metricsData = await metricsResponse.json();
        setBudgetMetrics({
          global_ceiling: metricsData.global_ceiling,
          total_spent: metricsData.total_spent
        });
      }

      addLog(`SUCCESS: Transited "${itemName}" to APPROVED. Updated budget metrics.`, 'text-emerald-400');
    } catch (err) {
      addLog(`ERROR: Approval failed - {err.message}`, 'text-red-400');
    }
  };

  const handleReturn = async (id, itemName) => {
    const remark = prompt("Enter Inline Remark / Revision Request for this Department:", "Canvas unverified. Please upload quotation proof.");
    if (!remark) return;

    try {
      const commentRes = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/${id}/return`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!commentRes.ok) throw new Error("Return state transition failed.");

      // Optional step: Add the remark to the comments thread of the proposal on the backend if required
      await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/dept/comments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text: remark,
          proposal_id: id,
          requires_department_action: true
        })
      });

      setProposals(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: 'Returned' } : p));
      setPendingCount(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
      
      addLog(`RETURNED: "${itemName}" set to Returned. Remark dispatched to department feedback loop.`, 'text-amber-400');
    } catch (err) {
      addLog(`ERROR: Return execution failed - ${err.message}`, 'text-red-400');
    }
  };

  const handleOverride = async (id, itemName) => {
    const newPriceInput = prompt(`Enter new verified unit cost (PHP) for "${itemName}":`);
    if (!newPriceInput) return;

    const newPrice = parseFloat(newPriceInput);
    if (isNaN(newPrice)) {
      alert("Invalid price format entered.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/${id}/override`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          hardware: { unit_cost: newPrice }
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Price override execution failed.");
      }

      setProposals(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, unit_cost: newPrice } : p));
      
      // Refresh globalspent metric
      fetchLiveProposals();
      addLog(`OVERRIDE: Applied price correction to "${itemName}". New rate: ₱${newPrice.toLocaleString()}`, 'text-blue-400');
    } catch (err) {
      addLog(`ERROR: Override failed: ${err.message}`, 'text-red-400');
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const triggerPDFGeneration = async () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    setGenerationComplete(false);
    addLog("INIT: Sending document trigger payload to Celery background workers...", "text-blue-400");

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/governance/generate-issp?issp_period=${activeCycle}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const errData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Compilation queue registration failed.");
      }
      const data = await response.json();
      
      if (data.status === "queued" || data.task_id) {
        addLog(`SUCCESS: Task queued. Celery Task ID: ${data.task_id}`, 'text-emerald-400');
        pollTaskStatus(data.task_id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      addLog(`ERROR: Task dispatch failed: ${err.message}`, 'text-red-400');
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const pollTaskStatus = async (taskId) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/governance/task-status/${taskId}`, {
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      const data = await res.json();

      if (data.state === "PROGRESS" || data.state === "PENDING") {
        addLog(`WORKER: ${data.meta?.status || 'Processing layout components...'}`, 'text-slate-400');
        setTimeout(() => pollTaskStatus(taskId), 1500);
      } else if (data.state === "SUCCESS") {
        setIsGenerating(false);
        setGenerationComplete(true);
        addLog("SUCCESS: Document compiled and saved to target vault.", "text-emerald-400");
        setDownloadUrl(data.result?.file_url || '');
      } else if (data.state === "FAILURE") {
        setIsGenerating(false);
        addLog(`ERROR: Compiling process crashed: ${data.error}`, 'text-red-400');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const utilizationPercent = budgetMetrics.global_ceiling > 0 
    ? (budgetMetrics.total_spent / budgetMetrics.global_ceiling) * 100 
    : 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100">
      {/* KPI Cards Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 rounded-lg">
            <Inbox className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{pendingCount}</h3>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Pending Review</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 rounded-lg">
            <CheckCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{approvedCount}</h3>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Approved Items</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-slate-300">
              <Landmark className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
              <span>Global Budget Ceiling Allocation</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-blue-400 bg-blue-950/50 border border-blue-900/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              FY {activeCycle}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
              <span>₱{budgetMetrics.total_spent.toLocaleString()} spent</span>
              <span>₱{budgetMetrics.global_ceiling.toLocaleString()} limit</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                className="bg-blue-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(utilizationPercent, 100)}%` }} 
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Queue Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900/50">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>Itemized Queue Consolidation (Annexes A-1 to A-6)</span>
          </h3>
          <button 
            onClick={fetchLiveProposals} 
            disabled={loading}
            className="p-1.5 px-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>Sync DB Queue</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-955 text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">
                <th className="p-4">Department</th>
                <th className="p-4">Proposed Item</th>
                <th className="p-4">Qty</th>
                <th className="p-4">Unit Cost</th>
                <th className="p-4">Canvas Proof</th>
                <th className="p-4">Status</th>
                <th className="p-4 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 text-slate-300">
              {proposals.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="7" className="p-12 text-center text-slate-500 italic">
                    No proposals logged in the planning queue.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                proposals.map(p => {
                  const isCustom = p.item_key === 'other';
                  const canvasFilename = p.canvas_evidence_url ? p.canvas_evidence_url.split('/').pop() : 'Missing';

                  return (
                    <tr key={p.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="p-4">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 text-[10px] text-blue-400 font-mono">
                          {getDeptName(p.department_id)}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4">
