          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              <Bolt className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>ISSP Document Compilation</span>
            </h4>
            <p className="text-slate-400 leading-relaxed text-[11px]">
              Compile approved multi-campus plans into the official compliance PDF. Includes ISO certification stamps, Batas Pambansa mandates, and project investment summaries.

                href={downloadUrl}

                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-center text-xs"

              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isGenerating ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>{isGenerating ? 'Compiling Layout Packages...' : 'Compile ISSP Document'}</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Live System Logging Output */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
          <div className="p-3 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-955 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Terminal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />

                  <span className="text-slate-600">[{log.time}]</span> <span className={log.type}>{log.text}</span>
                </div>
              ))}

        </div>

  );

// frontend/src/views/admin/Glossary/GlossaryManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import {
  getGlossary,
  createGlossaryTerm,
  updateGlossaryTerm,
  deleteGlossaryTerm
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit,
  BookOpen,
  Search,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  HelpCircle
} from "lucide-react";

export default function GlossaryManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [terms, setTerms] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    term: "",
    definition: ""
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchGlossaryTerms = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getGlossary(user.token);
      setTerms(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load glossary definitions.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchGlossaryTerms();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.term.trim()) return "Glossary term keyword or acronym is required.";
    if (!form.definition.trim()) return "Glossary term descriptive definition is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        term: form.term.trim(),
        definition: form.definition.trim()
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateGlossaryTerm(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("Glossary term updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createGlossaryTerm(user.token, payload);
        setSuccess("Glossary term preserved in database registry.");
      }

      // Reset form
      setForm({
        term: "",
        definition: ""
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchGlossaryTerms();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save glossary term.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (t) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(t.id);
    setForm({
      term: t.term,
      definition: t.definition
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setForm({
      term: "",
      definition: ""
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this definition of terms entry?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteGlossaryTerm(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Glossary term removed from registry.");
      fetchGlossaryTerms();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete glossary entry.");
    }
  };

  const filteredTerms = terms.filter(t =>
    t.term.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    t.definition.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Definition of Terms & Glossary (Pages 6-10)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Manage physical legal terms and DICT standard technical definitions preserved across ISSP compiling jobs.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Editor Form Box */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update Vocabulary Entry" : "Register Vocabulary Term"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Acronym / Keyword Term</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. MITHI or ISSP"
              value={form.term}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, term: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Descriptive Definition</label>
            <textarea
              placeholder="Technical or SUC operational definition mapping to this term..."
              value={form.definition}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, definition: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white h-40 resize-none leading-relaxed text-xs"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Term" : "Save Term"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Directory Grid */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Controls */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search vocabulary terms or definitions..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Table List View */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <BookOpen className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading physical dictionary indices...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredTerms.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/4">Acronym / Term</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-3/4">Descriptive Legal Definition</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredTerms.map(t => (
                    <tr key={t.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold font-mono text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start pt-3.5">
                        <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{t.term}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-slate-300 leading-relaxed max-w-lg break-words whitespace-pre-wrap">{t.definition}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleEdit(t)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Edit Term"
                          >
                            <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(t.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Purge Term"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No matching glossary vocabulary items registered.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Instructions/InstructionsManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import {
  getInstructions,
  createInstruction,
  updateInstruction,
  deleteInstruction
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit,
  ClipboardList,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  Hash,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown
} from "lucide-react";

export default function InstructionsManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [instructions, setInstructions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    step_number: 1,
    instruction_text: ""
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchInstructionsList = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getInstructions(user.token);
      // Sort instructions sequentially by step number ascending
      const sorted = data.sort((a, b) => a.step_number - b.step_number);
      setInstructions(sorted);
      
      // Auto-populate the next sequential step number for convenience
      if (!editId) {
        const nextStep = sorted.length > 0 ? sorted[sorted.length - 1].step_number + 1 : 1;
        setForm(f => ({ ...f, step_number: nextStep }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load submission instructions.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchInstructionsList();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (form.step_number <= 0) return "Step number must be a positive integer greater than zero.";
    if (!form.instruction_text.trim()) return "Instruction guideline text is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        step_number: parseInt(form.step_number, 10),
        instruction_text: form.instruction_text.trim()
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateInstruction(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("Instruction guideline updated successfully.");
      } else {
        // Prevent duplicate step indices locally before submission
        const isDuplicate = instructions.some(i => i.step_number === payload.step_number);
        if (isDuplicate) {
          setError(`Step number ${payload.step_number} is already registered. Please edit the existing step or use a different index.`);
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        await createInstruction(user.token, payload);
        setSuccess("Instruction guideline added successfully.");
      }

      // Reset form fields
      setForm({
        step_number: instructions.length + 2,
        instruction_text: ""
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchInstructionsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save submission instructions.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (inst) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(inst.id);
    setForm({
      step_number: inst.step_number,
      instruction_text: inst.instruction_text
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    const nextStep = instructions.length > 0 ? instructions[instructions.length - 1].step_number + 1 : 1;
    setForm({
      step_number: nextStep,
      instruction_text: ""
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this submission instruction step?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteInstruction(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Instruction step removed from registry.");
      fetchInstructionsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete instruction step.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title block */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <ClipboardList className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>General Submission Instructions Configuration (Page 11)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Manage global sequential instructions and guidelines rendered on the document compilation page.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Step configuration form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update Instruction Step" : "Append Instruction Step"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
              <Hash className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Step Execution Order</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="1"
              value={form.step_number}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, step_number: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1 })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-855 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Instruction Description Text</label>
            <textarea
              placeholder="Provide clean and descriptive guideline rules rendered on the submission guidelines sections..."
              value={form.instruction_text}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, instruction_text: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-855 rounded-lg text-white h-36 resize-none leading-relaxed"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Step" : "Save Step"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Directory Sequential Display */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-300 text-xs border-b border-slate-850 pb-3">
            Guidelines Step Sequencer Matrix
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <ClipboardList className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-indigo-500" />
                <span>Reading sequential index guidelines...</span>
              </div>
            ) : instructions.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-2">
                {instructions.map((inst, index) => (
                  <div key={inst.id} className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-4 hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors">
                    
                    {/* Index Circle Indicator */}
                    <span className="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-950/50 border border-indigo-900 text-indigo-400 font-mono font-bold shrink-0">
                      {inst.step_number}
                    </span>

                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed break-words">{inst.instruction_text}</p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Actions block */}
                    <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleEdit(inst)}
                        className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-850 rounded border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                        title="Edit Guideline"
                      >
                        <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(inst.id)}
                        className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-850 rounded border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                        title="Purge Guideline"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>

                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No guideline steps logged in sequential execution profiles.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Inventory/OfficeSoftwareManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import {
  getSoftwareCensus,
  createSoftwareCensus,
  deleteSoftwareCensus
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Search,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  FileCode,
  Layers,
  Hash
} from "lucide-react";

export default function OfficeSoftwareManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [census, setCensus] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    software_name: "",
    license_count: 0
  });

  // Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchCensusList = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getSoftwareCensus(user.token);
      setCensus(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load office software census properties.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchCensusList();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.software_name.trim()) return "Software platform name is required.";
    if (form.license_count < 0) return "License count cannot be a negative value.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        software_name: form.software_name.trim(),
        license_count: parseInt(form.license_count, 10) || 0
      };

      await createSoftwareCensus(user.token, payload);
      setSuccess("Software census entry recorded successfully.");

      // Reset form
      setForm({
        software_name: "",
        license_count: 0
      });
      fetchCensusList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to preserve software census record.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this software license census record?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteSoftwareCensus(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Software census record removed successfully.");
      fetchCensusList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to purge software platform from census.");
    }
  };

  const filteredCensus = census.filter(c =>
    c.software_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  const totalLicenses = census.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.license_count || 0), 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileCode className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>DICT Section 2.2: SUC Office Software Census Registry</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Track license counts and software assets for office suites, database structures, and platform configurations.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-slate-950 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          <div className="text-right">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Total Seats Logged:</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold text-sm">{totalLicenses.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Registration Form Box */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Record Software Asset</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Software Platform / Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Microsoft Office Professional 2021"
              value={form.software_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, software_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-semibold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">License Volume / Counts</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min="0"
                placeholder="0"
                value={form.license_count}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, license_count: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0 })}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all pt-2"
          >
            <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Documenting..." : "Save Record"}</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Inventory Directory */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Search Controls */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search software products..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Table list */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <FileCode className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading SUC software census registry...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredCensus.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-3/4">SoftwarePlatform / Suite Name</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/4">Seat Count / Licenses</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredCensus.map(c => (
                    <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-slate-200 font-bold leading-relaxed">{c.software_name}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono font-bold text-blue-400">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded">
                          <span>{c.license_count.toLocaleString()}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">seats</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Purge Record"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No matching software platforms or applications registered.

  );

// frontend/src/views/admin/Inventory/OsCensusManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import {
  getOsCensus,
  createOsCensusRecord,
  updateOsCensusRecord,
  deleteOsCensusRecord
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit,
  Search,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  Monitor,
  Server,
  Layers,
  Database
} from "lucide-react";

export default function OsCensusManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [census, setCensus] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    os_name: "",
    workstations_count: 0,
    servers_count: 0
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchCensusList = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getOsCensus(user.token);
      setCensus(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load client OS census directory.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchCensusList();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.os_name.trim()) return "Operating System name is required.";
    if (form.workstations_count < 0) return "Workstations count cannot be negative.";
    if (form.servers_count < 0) return "Servers count cannot be negative.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        os_name: form.os_name.trim(),
        workstations_count: parseInt(form.workstations_count, 10) || 0,
        servers_count: parseInt(form.servers_count, 10) || 0
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateOsCensusRecord(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("Census record updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createOsCensusRecord(user.token, payload);
        setSuccess("Census record registered successfully.");
      }

      // Reset Form
      setForm({
        os_name: "",
        workstations_count: 0,
        servers_count: 0
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchCensusList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save OS census record.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (item) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(item.id);
    setForm({
      os_name: item.os_name,
      workstations_count: item.workstations_count,
      servers_count: item.servers_count
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setForm({
      os_name: "",
      workstations_count: 0,
      servers_count: 0
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this operating system census record?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteOsCensusRecord(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Operating system registry purged.");
      fetchCensusList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete census record.");
    }
  };

  // Aggregated summaries
  const totalWorkstations = census.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.workstations_count || 0), 0);
  const totalServers = census.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.servers_count || 0), 0);
  const totalDevices = totalWorkstations + totalServers;

  const filteredCensus = census.filter(c =>
    c.os_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Block */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>DICT Section 2.1: Client OS License Census</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Audit and record active operating system platforms, workstation installations, and network servers.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Aggregate Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-900 rounded-lg text-blue-400">
            <Monitor className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Total Workstations</div>
            <div className="text-xl font-mono font-bold text-white mt-0.5">{totalWorkstations.toLocaleString()}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="p-3 bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-900 rounded-lg text-purple-400">
            <Server className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Total Servers</div>
            <div className="text-xl font-mono font-bold text-white mt-0.5">{totalServers.toLocaleString()}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900 rounded-lg text-emerald-400">
            <Database className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Overall Installations</div>
            <div className="text-xl font-mono font-bold text-white mt-0.5">{totalDevices.toLocaleString()}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Editor Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update OS Platform" : "Add OS Platform"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Operating System platform</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Windows 11 Enterprise"
              value={form.os_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, os_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Workstations Count</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              placeholder="0"
              value={form.workstations_count}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, workstations_count: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0 })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Servers Count</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              placeholder="0"
              value={form.servers_count}

              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
              required

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (

                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Platform" : "Save Platform"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Directory Grid Table */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Controls */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">

                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input

                placeholder="Search operating systems..."

              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <Layers className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading physical license registers...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredCensus.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/2">Operating System platform</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Workstations</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Servers</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredCensus.map(c => (
                    <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-slate-200">{c.os_name}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono text-slate-300 font-semibold">{c.workstations_count.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono text-slate-300 font-semibold">{c.servers_count.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleEdit(c)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Edit Record"
                          >
                            <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Purge Record"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No matching client operating platforms listed.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Inventory/ServerCapacityManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import {
  getServerCapacities,
  createServerCapacity,
  deleteServerCapacity,
  getCampuses
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Server,
  HardDrive,
  MapPin,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  RefreshCw
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ServerCapacityManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [capacities, setCapacities] = useState([]);
  const [campuses, setCampuses] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    campus_id: "",
    capacity_tier: "Above 4TB",
    location: "IN-HOUSE",
    quantity: ""
  });

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchRegistryAndCampuses = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [capsData, campsData] = await Promise.all([
        getServerCapacities(user.token),
        getCampuses(user.token)
      ]);
      setCapacities(capsData);
      setCampuses(campsData);
      
      // Auto-select first campus if available
      if (campsData.length > 0) {
        setForm(f => ({ ...f, campus_id: campsData[0].id }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to query storage hardware properties.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchRegistryAndCampuses();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.campus_id) return "Please associate a campus with this hardware record.";
    const qtyInt = parseInt(form.quantity, 10);
    if (isNaN(qtyInt) || qtyInt < 0) return "Physical hardware quantity must be a non-negative integer.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        campus_id: parseInt(form.campus_id, 10),
        capacity_tier: form.capacity_tier,
        location: form.location,
        quantity: parseInt(form.quantity, 10)
      };

      await createServerCapacity(user.token, payload);
      setSuccess("Server storage profile mapped successfully.");
      
      // Reset numeric count but preserve current selection states
      setForm(f => ({ ...f, quantity: "" }));
      
      // Refresh registry
      const updatedCaps = await getServerCapacities(user.token);
      setCapacities(updatedCaps);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save server storage configuration.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this storage capacity inventory entry?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteServerCapacity(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Server storage allocation record deleted.");
      
      // Refresh registry
      const updatedCaps = await getServerCapacities(user.token);
      setCapacities(updatedCaps);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to remove inventory record.");
    }
  };

  // Maps physical campus database entries to records for display
  const resolveCampusDetails = (campusId) => {
    const campus = campuses.find(c => c.id === campusId);
    return campus ? `${campus.name} (${campus.code})` : `Campus ID: ${campusId}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title block */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Server className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>DICT Annex A-1 Server Storage Capacity Registry (Section 1.3)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Audit and record university server locations and physical storage capacity profiles.</p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchRegistryAndCampuses}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Records</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Record Entry Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Map Storage Hardware</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Target University Campus</label>
            <select
              value={form.campus_id}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, campus_id: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            >
              <option value="" disabled>Select campus branch...</option>
              {campuses.map(c => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name} ({c.code})</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Storage Tier Capacity</label>
            <select
              value={form.capacity_tier}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, capacity_tier: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="Above 4TB">Above 4TB</option>
              <option value="2TB to 4TB">2TB to 4TB</option>
              <option value="Below 2TB">Below 2TB</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Site Deployment Classification</label>
            <select
              value={form.location}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, location: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="IN-HOUSE">IN-HOUSE (On-Premises Server Room)</option>
              <option value="CO-LOCATED">CO-LOCATED (External Datacenter)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Server Count Quantity</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              placeholder="e.g. 5"
              value={form.quantity}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, quantity: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting || campuses.length === 0}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : "Save Record"}</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Storage Hardwares Table Grid */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <HardDrive className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading inventory data...</span>
              </div>
            ) : capacities.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Associated SUC Campus</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">HDD Storage Tier</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Deployment Location</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Count</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {capacities.map(c => (
                    <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-slate-200">
                        {resolveCampusDetails(c.campus_id)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono text-slate-300">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <HardDrive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                          <span>{c.capacity_tier}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2">
                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
                          c.location === "IN-HOUSE"
                            ? "bg-blue-950/40 border-blue-900 text-blue-300"
                            : "bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-900 text-purple-300"
                        }`}>
                          <MapPin className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{c.location}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono font-bold text-blue-400">{c.quantity}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)}
                          className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Delete Record"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (

      </div>
    </div>
  );

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/CoreOfficesManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import {
  getOfficeFunctions,
  createOfficeFunction,
  updateOfficeFunction,
  deleteOfficeFunction
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit,
  Building,
  Search,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  Briefcase,
  Layers,
  Filter
} from "lucide-react";

export default function CoreOfficesManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [offices, setOffices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    office_name: "",
    division: "Administration",
    description: ""
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Filters State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterDivision, setFilterDivision] = useState("All");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchOfficesList = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getOfficeFunctions(user.token, activeCycle);
      setOffices(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load SUC core offices directory.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchOfficesList();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.office_name.trim()) return "Office name is required.";
    if (!form.description.trim()) return "Functional description of SUC office is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        office_name: form.office_name.trim(),
        division: form.division,
        description: form.description.trim()
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateOfficeFunction(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("Office profile updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createOfficeFunction(user.token, activeCycle, payload);
        setSuccess("Office profile documented successfully.");
      }

      // Reset Form State
      setForm({
        office_name: "",
        division: "Administration",
        description: ""
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchOfficesList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save core office metrics.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (o) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(o.id);
    setForm({
      office_name: o.office_name,
      division: o.division,
      description: o.description
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setForm({
      office_name: "",
      division: "Administration",
      description: ""
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this office and its legal descriptions?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteOfficeFunction(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Office documented registry cleared.");
      fetchOfficesList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete office profile.");
    }
  };

  const filteredOffices = offices.filter(o => {
    const matchesSearch = 
      o.office_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      o.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    
    const matchesDivision = filterDivision === "All" || o.division === filterDivision;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesDivision;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Building className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
            <span>Annex A-3: Core SUC Offices Directory</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Manage physical college administrative units, divisions, and legally mandated organizational roles.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-900 rounded font-bold font-mono text-purple-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Cycle: {activeCycle || "Unassigned"}
        </span>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Editor Form Box */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update Office Profile" : "Document Office Profile"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Office Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Office of the SUC President"
              value={form.office_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, office_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Organizational Division</label>
            <select
              value={form.division}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, division: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="Administration">Administration</option>
              <option value="Academic">Academic</option>
              <option value="Research">Research & Extension</option>
              <option value="Finance">Finance</option>
              <option value="Support">Academic Support</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Functional Responsibilities</label>
            <textarea
              placeholder="Mandated functions, legal responsibilities, or workflow definitions..."
              value={form.description}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white h-36 resize-none leading-relaxed"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Profile" : "Save Profile"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Directory Search Panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Filtering Controls */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search offices or responsibilities..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-auto">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Division:</span>
              <select
                value={filterDivision}
                onChange={e => setFilterDivision(e.target.value)}
                className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded text-[10px] font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wide cursor-pointer focus:outline-none"
              >
                <option value="All">ALL DIVISIONS</option>
                <option value="Administration">ADMINISTRATION</option>
                <option value="Academic">ACADEMIC</option>
                <option value="Research">RESEARCH & EXTENSION</option>
                <option value="Finance">FINANCE</option>
                <option value="Support">ACADEMIC SUPPORT</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Table display */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <Building className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-purple-500" />
                <span>Reading core offices directory...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredOffices.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/4">Office / Administrative Unit</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/5">Division Category</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-2/5">Functional Description</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850 text-slate-300">
                  {filteredOffices.map(o => (
                    <tr key={o.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-slate-200">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span>{o.office_name}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-950/40 px-2.5 py-1 border border-slate-850 rounded text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-purple-400">
                          <Layers className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                          <span>{o.division}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 leading-relaxed text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[240px] select-all" title={o.description}>
                        {o.description}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleEdit(o)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Edit Office Profile"
                          >
                            <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(o.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Purge Office Profile"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No core offices mapped for category filter.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
