// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/CostBreakdownManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import {
  getAnnualCosts,
  createAnnualCost,
  deleteAnnualCost
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Coins,
  Search,
  Filter,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  Calculator,
  CalendarDays,
  Layers
} from "lucide-react";

export default function CostBreakdownManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, planningYears } = useCycle();
  const [costs, setCosts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    project_key: "LMS",
    cost_type: "CapEx",
    item_description: "",
    unit_cost: ""
  });
  const [yearlyQty, setYearlyQty] = useState({});

  // Search & Filter State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterCostType, setFilterCostType] = useState("All");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Synchronize yearly quantity input fields whenever planning years adjust
  useEffect(() => {
    if (planningYears && planningYears.length > 0) {
      const initialQtys = {};
      planningYears.forEach(year => {
        initialQtys[String(year)] = 0;
      });
      setYearlyQty(initialQtys);
    }
  }, [planningYears]);

  const fetchCostsList = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getAnnualCosts(user.token, activeCycle);
      setCosts(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load cost breakdown ledger.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchCostsList();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const handleQtyChange = (year, value) => {
    const valInt = parseInt(value, 10);
    setYearlyQty(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [String(year)]: isNaN(valInt) || valInt < 0 ? 0 : valInt
    }));
  };

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.item_description.trim()) return "Item description is required.";
    const costNum = parseFloat(form.unit_cost);
    if (isNaN(costNum) || costNum < 0) return "Unit cost must be a non-negative number.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        project_key: form.project_key,
        cost_type: form.cost_type,
        item_description: form.item_description.trim(),
        unit_cost: parseFloat(form.unit_cost),
        yearly_quantities: yearlyQty
      };

      await createAnnualCost(user.token, activeCycle, payload);
      setSuccess("Cost line item recorded successfully.");

      // Reset Form fields
      setForm({
        project_key: "LMS",
        cost_type: "CapEx",
        item_description: "",
        unit_cost: ""
      });
      
      // Reset quantities back to zeros
      const resetQtys = {};
      planningYears.forEach(year => {
        resetQtys[String(year)] = 0;
      });
      setYearlyQty(resetQtys);

      fetchCostsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to record annual cost mapping.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this cost item allocation?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteAnnualCost(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Cost line item successfully removed.");
      fetchCostsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete cost allocation entry.");
    }
  };

  // Live calculation of item subtotal for active form editing
  const getFormSubtotal = () => {
    const cost = parseFloat(form.unit_cost) || 0;
    const totalQty = Object.values(yearlyQty).reduce((sum, qty) => sum + qty, 0);
    return cost * totalQty;
  };

  const filteredCosts = costs.filter(c => {
    const matchesSearch = 
      c.item_description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      c.project_key.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    
    const matchesType = filterCostType === "All" || c.cost_type === filterCostType;
    return matchesSearch && matchesType;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Coins className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
            <span>Part V.D & Annex A-5: Detailed Cost Breakdown Matrix</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Record Multi-Year cost estimates, MOOE software licenses, and continuing SUC operational budgets.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900 rounded font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Cycle: {activeCycle || "Unassigned"}
        </span>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Editor Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
            <span>Map Cost Item Allocation</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Associated Strategic Project</label>
            <select
              value={form.project_key}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, project_key: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
            >
              <option value="LMS">LMS - Deployment of Moodle LMS</option>
              <option value="WiFi">WIFI - Upgrading and Expansion of WiFi Network</option>
              <option value="VOIP">VOIP - Upgrade SUC PABX to Unified Voice Pipelines</option>
              <option value="Portal">PORTAL - SUC Student & Enrollment Portal Integration</option>
              <option value="Security">SECURITY - Deployment of SUC Next-Gen Firewall Modules</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Expenditure Category</label>
            <select
              value={form.cost_type}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, cost_type: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-bold text-emerald-400"
            >
              <option value="CapEx">CapEx (Capital Outlay / Hardware)</option>
              <option value="MOOE">MOOE (Software / Dynamic Licenses)</option>
              <option value="Continuing">Continuing SUC Operational Costs</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Item Description</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Enterprise Access Point Layer 3"
              value={form.item_description}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, item_description: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Unit Rate (PHP ₱)</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              step="0.01"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={form.unit_cost}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, unit_cost: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          {/* Dynamic Yearly Allocations */}
          <div className="space-y-3 p-4 bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-850">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
              <CalendarDays className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Multi-Year Deployment Quantities</span>
            </span>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {planningYears.map(year => (
                <div key={year} className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300">Fiscal Year {year}</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    placeholder="0"
                    value={yearlyQty[String(year)] || 0}
                    onChange={e => handleQtyChange(year, e.target.value)}
                    className="w-20 p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-center rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Estimated Item Total */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-900/40 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-slate-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
              <Calculator className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
              <span>Projected Line Total:</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400">
              ₱{getFormSubtotal().toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
          >
            <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : "Save Cost Item"}</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Cost Matrix Register Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Controls bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search allocations or project keys..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-auto">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Type:</span>
              <div className="flex bg-slate-950 rounded-lg p-0.5 border border-slate-850">
                {["All", "CapEx", "MOOE", "Continuing"].map(type => (
                  <button
                    key={type}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterCostType(type)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterCostType === type 
                        ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white" 
                        : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {type}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Directory Listings */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <Coins className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-emerald-500" />
                <span>Reading budget matrices...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredCosts.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Project</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Item Description</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Category</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Unit Cost</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Deployment Schedule</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredCosts.map(c => {
                    const totalQty = Object.values(c.yearly_quantities || {}).reduce((sum, q) => sum + q, 0);
                    const calculatedTotalCost = parseFloat(c.unit_cost) * totalQty;

                    return (
                      <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-3 px-2">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-400 bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-900/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">
                            {c.project_key}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-slate-200">{c.item_description}</td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-2">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                            c.cost_type === "CapEx"
                              ? "bg-blue-955/40 border border-blue-900 text-blue-300"
                              : c.cost_type === "MOOE"
                              ? "bg-purple-955/40 border border-purple-900 text-purple-300"
                              : "bg-amber-955/40 border border-amber-900 text-amber-300"
                          }`}>
                            {c.cost_type}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono text-slate-300">
                          ₱{parseFloat(c.unit_cost).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-2">
                          <div className="flex gap-2 items-center text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            {Object.entries(c.yearly_quantities || {}).map(([yr, qty]) => (
                              <span key={yr} className="bg-slate-950 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-850" title={`FY ${yr}`}>
                                {yr}: <strong className="text-slate-200">{qty}</strong>
                              </span>
                            ))}
                            <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400 border-l border-slate-800 pl-2">
                              ₱{calculatedTotalCost.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Remove Allocation"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No cost breakdown allocations mapped for cycle period '{activeCycle}'.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/CrossProjectsManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import {
  getCrossProjects,
  createCrossProject,
  deleteCrossProject
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Search,
  Network,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
  Building,
  Target,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle
} from "lucide-react";

export default function CrossProjectsManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    objectives: "",
    duration: "",
    deliverables: "",
    lead_agency: "",
    implementing_agencies: ""
  });

  // Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Notifications State
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchProjectsList = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getCrossProjects(user.token, activeCycle);
      setProjects(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load cross-agency projects.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchProjectsList();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return "Project name is required.";
    if (!form.objectives.trim()) return "Objectives are required.";
    if (!form.duration.trim()) return "Duration description is required.";
    if (!form.deliverables.trim()) return "Deliverables explanation is required.";
    if (!form.lead_agency.trim()) return "Lead Agency name is required.";
    if (!form.implementing_agencies.trim()) return "At least one implementing agency is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: form.name.trim(),
        objectives: form.objectives.trim(),
        duration: form.duration.trim(),
        deliverables: form.deliverables.trim(),
        lead_agency: form.lead_agency.trim(),
        implementing_agencies: form.implementing_agencies.trim()
      };

      await createCrossProject(user.token, activeCycle, payload);
      setSuccess("Cross-agency cooperative project successfully registered.");
      
      // Reset Form
      setForm({
        name: "",
        objectives: "",
        duration: "",
        deliverables: "",
        lead_agency: "",
        implementing_agencies: ""
      });
      fetchProjectsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to register cooperative project.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this cooperative project entry?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteCrossProject(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Collaborative project purged successfully.");
      fetchProjectsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete project.");
    }
  };

  const filteredProjects = projects.filter(p =>
    p.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    p.lead_agency.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    p.implementing_agencies.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title block */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Network className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Part III.B: Unified SUC Cross-Agency Collaborative Projects</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Manage joint digital pipeline initiatives undertaken with external agencies (e.g. DICT, CHED, SUCs).</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-900 rounded font-bold font-mono text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Cycle: {activeCycle || "Unassigned"}
        </span>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Registration Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">

              value={form.name}

              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-semibold"

              required
            />
          </div>

            ) : filteredProjects.length > 0 ? (
              filteredProjects.map(p => (

                  {/* Top bar */}
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-4">

                    <span className="text-slate-400 ml-1.5">{p.implementing_agencies}</span>
                  </div>

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/DegreeOfferings.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { 
  getDegrees, 
  createDegree, 
  updateDegree, 
  deleteDegree 
} from "../../../api/admin";
import { 
  Save, 
  Trash2, 
  Plus, 
  Edit3, 
  GraduationCap, 
  Award, 
  Search, 
  X, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle,
  Filter
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DegreeOfferings() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [degrees, setDegrees] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    department_name: "",
    degree_name: "",
    level: "Undergraduate",
    accreditation_status: ""
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Search & Filter State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterLevel, setFilterLevel] = useState("All");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchDegreesList = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getDegrees(user.token);
      setDegrees(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load academic programs registry.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchDegreesList();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.department_name.trim()) return "Department or College name is required.";
    if (!form.degree_name.trim()) return "Academic program/Degree name is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        department_name: form.department_name.trim(),
        degree_name: form.degree_name.trim(),
        level: form.level,
        accreditation_status: form.accreditation_status.trim() || "Not Accredited"
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateDegree(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("Academic program updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createDegree(user.token, payload);
        setSuccess("Academic program added to registry.");
      }

      // Reset form
      setForm({
        department_name: "",
        degree_name: "",
        level: "Undergraduate",
        accreditation_status: ""
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchDegreesList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save academic program.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (d) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(d.id);
    setForm({
      department_name: d.department_name,
      degree_name: d.degree_name,
      level: d.level,
      accreditation_status: d.accreditation_status || ""
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setForm({
      department_name: "",
      degree_name: "",
      level: "Undergraduate",
      accreditation_status: ""
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this academic program?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteDegree(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Academic program removed from registry.");
      fetchDegreesList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete academic program.");
    }
  };

  // Filter and Search logic
  const filteredDegrees = degrees.filter(d => {
    const matchesSearch = 
      d.degree_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      d.department_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (d.accreditation_status && d.accreditation_status.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()));
    
    const matchesLevel = filterLevel === "All" || d.level === filterLevel;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesLevel;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title block */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Annex A-4 Academic Program Offerings Directory</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Manage physical CHED degree offerings and legal accreditation levels.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Editor Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update Academic Program" : "Register Academic Program"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">College / Department Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. College of Engineering"
              value={form.department_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, department_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Degree / Program Title</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. BS Civil Engineering"
              value={form.degree_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, degree_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Program Level</label>
            <select
              value={form.level}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, level: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="Undergraduate">Undergraduate Degree</option>
              <option value="Graduate">Graduate / Masteral Degree</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Accreditation Status</span>
              <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 normal-case">Optional</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Level III Re-Accredited"
              value={form.accreditation_status}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, accreditation_status: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Defaults to "Not Accredited" if left blank.</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Program" : "Save Program"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Records Directory Grid */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Controls Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search by college or degree..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-auto">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Classification:</span>
              <div className="flex bg-slate-950 rounded-lg p-0.5 border border-slate-850">
                {["All", "Undergraduate", "Graduate"].map(level => (
                  <button
                    key={level}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterLevel(level)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterLevel === level 
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" 
                        : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {level}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Directory Listings */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <GraduationCap className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading physical program directory...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredDegrees.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/3">Department / College</th>

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/DiagramVault.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { ImageIcon, Upload, CheckCircle, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, FileImage } from "lucide-react";

export default function DiagramVault() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Tracks localized upload loaders per category key instead of locking the entire workspace
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState({});

  const [diagrams, setDiagrams] = useState({
    agency_logo: null,
    cert_logo: null,
    process_flow_diagram: null,
    org_chart: null,
    functional_interface: null,
    conceptual_framework: null,
    network_layout: null,
    existing_ict_org: null,
    proposed_ict_org: null,
    placement_ict_org: null,
    site_development_plan: null,
    fiber_backbone: null,
    system_architecture: null,
    network_topology: null
  });

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchDiagrams = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setDiagrams({
          agency_logo: data.agency_logo_url,
          cert_logo: data.cert_logo_url,
          process_flow_diagram: data.process_flow_diagram_url,
          org_chart: data.org_chart_url,
          functional_interface: data.functional_interface_url,
          conceptual_framework: data.conceptual_framework_url,
          network_layout: data.network_layout_url,
          existing_ict_org: data.existing_ict_org_url,
          proposed_ict_org: data.proposed_ict_org_url,
          placement_ict_org: data.placement_ict_org_url,
          site_development_plan: data.site_development_plan_url,
          fiber_backbone: data.fiber_backbone_url,
          system_architecture: data.system_architecture_url,
          network_topology: data.network_topology_url
        });
      } else {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to retrieve existing diagram paths.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchDiagrams();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  const handleUpload = async (category, file) => {
    if (!file) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    // Assert localized card-level loading state
    setUploading(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: true }));

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}/upload-diagram?category=${category}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: formData
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to upload diagram.");
      }

      const resData = await res.json();
      setSuccess(`Successfully uploaded diagram for: '${category}'`);
      setDiagrams(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: resData.file_url }));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setUploading(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: false }));
    }
  };

  const categories = [
    { key: "agency_logo", title: "Institutional Brand Logo" },
    { key: "cert_logo", title: "Certification Badge (TUV SUD)" },
    { key: "process_flow_diagram", title: "ISSP Process Flow Diagram (Section iii)" },
    { key: "org_chart", title: "General College Org Structure" },
    { key: "functional_interface", title: "I.C. SUC Functional Interface Diagram" },
    { key: "conceptual_framework", title: "Conceptual IS Architecture" },
    { key: "network_layout", title: "Logical LAN Network Layout" },
    { key: "existing_ict_org", title: "Part IV.B: Existing ICT Organizational Chart" },
    { key: "proposed_ict_org", title: "Part IV.B: Proposed ICT Organizational Structure" },
    { key: "placement_ict_org", title: "Part IV.B: Placement of Proposed ICT in Institutional Chart" },
    { key: "site_development_plan", title: "Annex A-2 Campus Site Development Plan" },
    { key: "network_topology", title: "CSPC Network Diagram & Core Topology (Page 129)" },
    { key: "fiber_backbone", title: "Fiber Optic Backbone Cabling Layout (Page 130)" },
    { key: "system_architecture", title: "CSPC Unified System Architecture (Page 131)" }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <ImageIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>DICT Standard Schematics & Diagram Vault</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Store and manage high-resolution architecture diagrams. File sizes are capped at 5MB per upload.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/30 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-slate-500 gap-2">
          <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
          <span>Reading active attachments...</span>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          {categories.map((cat) => (
            <div key={cat.key} className="bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">
                  <FileImage className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                  <span>{cat.title}</span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">S3 target path: diagrams/{cat.key}/*</p>
              </div>

              {uploading[cat.key] ? (
                <div className="bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 h-40 flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-blue-500 mb-2" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Uploading diagram binary...</span>
                </div>
              ) : diagrams[cat.key] ? (
                <div className="bg-slate-955 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 h-40 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                  <img src={diagrams[cat.key]} alt={cat.title} className="max-w-full max-h-full object-contain" />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="bg-slate-955 border border-dashed border-slate-850 h-40 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-slate-600 font-semibold italic">
                  No diagram registered
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-slate-850/80 pt-3 text-xs">
                <input 
                  type="file" accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/jpg, image/gif"
                  onChange={(e) => handleUpload(cat.key, e.target.files[0])}
                  className="w-full text-[11px] text-slate-400 file:mr-4 file:py-1.5 file:px-3 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:text-[10px] file:font-bold file:bg-slate-800 file:text-slate-300 hover:file:bg-slate-700 file:cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/GaaTargets.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import {
  getGaaTargets,
  createGaaTarget,
  updateGaaTarget,
  deleteGaaTarget
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  CheckCircle2,
  Target,
  Search,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle
} from "lucide-react";

export default function GaaTargets() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [targets, setTargets] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    indicator_name: "",
    target_value: ""
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchTargetsList = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getGaaTargets(user.token);
      setTargets(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load GAA performance targets registry.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchTargetsList();
    }
  }, [user]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.indicator_name.trim()) return "Performance Indicator description is required.";
    if (!form.target_value.trim()) return "Target value is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        indicator_name: form.indicator_name.trim(),
        target_value: form.target_value.trim()
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateGaaTarget(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("GAA target indicator updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createGaaTarget(user.token, payload);
        setSuccess("GAA performance target added to registry.");
      }

      // Reset form
      setForm({
        indicator_name: "",
        target_value: ""
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchTargetsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save GAA target indicator.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (t) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(t.id);
    setForm({
      indicator_name: t.indicator_name,
      target_value: t.target_value
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setForm({
      indicator_name: "",
      target_value: ""
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this performance indicator target?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteGaaTarget(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("GAA target indicator removed from registry.");
      fetchTargetsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete target metric.");
    }
  };

  const filteredTargets = targets.filter(t => 
    t.indicator_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    t.target_value.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
            <span>GAA Target Performance Indicators (Annex A-4)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Manage physical SUC Legislative and General Appropriations Act baseline target outcomes.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Registration Form Box */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update Performance Indicator" : "Register Target Indicator"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Indicator Description</label>
            <textarea
              placeholder="e.g. Percentage of first-time licensure exam passers..."
              value={form.indicator_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, indicator_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white h-24 resize-none leading-relaxed"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">GAA Baseline Target</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. 50% or 100 Graduates"
              value={form.target_value}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, target_value: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Metric" : "Save Metric"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Targets Directory Grid */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Search Controls */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search indicators or target values..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Directory Listings */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <Target className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-emerald-500" />
                <span>Reading GAA performance registries...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredTargets.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-3/4">Performance Indicator Description</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-1/4">GAA Baseline Target</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredTargets.map(t => (
                    <tr key={t.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-slate-200 leading-relaxed max-w-md break-words">{t.indicator_name}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-950/40 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-emerald-900/50">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                          <span>{t.target_value}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleEdit(t)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Edit Metric"
                          >
                            <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(t.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Purge Metric"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No matching performance milestones registered.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/GanttScheduleManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  Save, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
  ChevronRight
} from "lucide-react";

export default function GanttScheduleManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, planningYears } = useCycle();
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiEndpoint = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;

  const fetchSchedules = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to load SUC project implementation timelines.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      
      // Safe fallback if implementation_schedules is not defined or is null
      setSchedules(data.implementation_schedules || []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to retrieve implementation schedule matrices.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchSchedules();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const handleToggleQuarter = (projectIndex, key) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    
    const updatedSchedules = [...schedules];
    const project = updatedSchedules[projectIndex];
    
    // Ensure milestones dictionary exists
    if (!project.milestones) {
      project.milestones = {};
    }
    
    // Toggle state value
    project.milestones[key] = !project.milestones[key];
    setSchedules(updatedSchedules);
  };

  const handleSaveTimelines = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ implementation_schedules: schedules })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to preserve quarterly implementation milestones.");
      }

      setSuccess("Gantt timeline implementation schedule preserved successfully.");
      fetchSchedules();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save Gantt milestone configurations.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const quarters = ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Interactive Gantt Timeline Editor (Part V.A/B)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Configure quarterly deployment milestones and schedules across the 3-year planning horizon.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={fetchSchedules}
            disabled={loading}
            className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            title="Refresh Milestones"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleSaveTimelines}
            disabled={submitting || loading || schedules.length === 0}
            className="py-2 px-4 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all disabled:bg-slate-800 disabled:text-slate-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : "Save Timelines"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Timeline Editor Board */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-955/60 font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
            <span>Deployment Milestones Matrix</span>
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded font-mono text-blue-400 font-bold">
            Horizon: {activeCycle || "N/A"}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Parsing schedule matrix...</span>
            </div>
          ) : schedules.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-center border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-950 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="p-4 text-left border-r border-b border-slate-800 w-1/4 min-w-[240px]">Project Strategic Module</th>
                  {planningYears.map(year => (
                    <th key={year} colSpan={4} className="border-r border-b border-slate-800 text-xs py-2 font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-200">
                      FY {year}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
                <tr className="bg-slate-900/40 font-mono text-[9px] text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-800">
                  <th className="border-r border-slate-800"></th>
                  {planningYears.map(year => (
                    quarters.map(q => (
                      <th key={`${year}_${q}`} className="border-r border-slate-800 py-1.5 uppercase font-bold">
                        {q}
                      </th>
                    ))
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                {schedules.map((row, projectIdx) => (
                  <tr key={row.project_id || projectIdx} className="hover:bg-slate-955/10 transition-colors">
                    {/* Project Title */}
                    <td className="text-left font-bold p-4 border-r border-slate-800 text-slate-200 max-w-[240px] break-words">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{row.project_name}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Timeline Block Toggles */}
                    {planningYears.map(year => (
                      quarters.map(q => {
                        const key = `${year}_${q}`;
                        const active = !!row.milestones?.[key];
                        return (
                          <td key={key} className="border-r border-slate-850 p-2 relative">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleToggleQuarter(projectIdx, key)}
                              className={`w-full h-8 rounded-md border cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 ${
                                active 
                                  ? "bg-blue-600/30 border-blue-500 text-blue-400 font-bold shadow-inner shadow-blue-500/20" 
                                  : "bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-850 text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-950"
                              }`}
                              title={`${row.project_name} - FY ${year} ${q}`}
                            >
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono select-none">
                                {active ? "ACTIVE" : ""}
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        );
                      })
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
              No project implementation schedules configured for active cycle '{activeCycle}'. Ensure proposals are categorized under standard projects.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/MithiSurveys.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { Save, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Network, HardDrive } from "lucide-react";

export default function MithiSurveys() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Network Profile States
  const [hasLan, setHasLan] = useState(true);
  const [hasIntranet, setHasIntranet] = useState(false);
  const [hasVpn, setHasVpn] = useState(false);
  const [internetBandwidth, setInternetBandwidth] = useState("");

  // Data Center profile states
  const [hasDataCenter, setHasDataCenter] = useState(true);
  const [activeServersCount, setActiveServersCount] = useState(0);
  const [hasBackupSite, setHasBackupSite] = useState(false);
  const [maintenanceStrategy, setMaintenanceStrategy] = useState("In-house");

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchSurvey = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const net = data.mithi_network_profile || {};
        setHasLan(net.has_lan ?? true);
        setHasIntranet(net.has_intranet ?? false);
        setHasVpn(net.has_vpn ?? false);
        setInternetBandwidth(String(net.combined_bandwidth_mbps || ""));

        const dc = data.mithi_data_center || {};
        setHasDataCenter(dc.has_data_center ?? true);
        setActiveServersCount(dc.data_center_count || 0);
        setHasBackupSite(dc.has_backup_site ?? false);
        setMaintenanceStrategy(dc.maintenance_strategy || "In-house");
      } else {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to query the survey template.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchSurvey();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const networkPayload = {
      has_lan: hasLan,
      has_intranet: hasIntranet,
      has_vpn: hasVpn,
      is_connected_to_internet: true,
      internet_access_modes: ["Leased Line"],
      isps: ["PLDT"],
      combined_bandwidth_mbps: parseInt(internetBandwidth, 10) || 0,
      employees_with_internet_access: 100,
      employees_with_official_email: 100
    };

    const dcPayload = {
      has_data_center: hasDataCenter,
      data_center_count: parseInt(activeServersCount, 10) || 0,
      has_backup_site: hasBackupSite,
      maintenance_strategy: maintenanceStrategy
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          mithi_network_profile: networkPayload,
          mithi_data_center: dcPayload
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to update MITHI survey database data.");
      }
      
      setSuccess("Annex A-1 Technical MITHI Survey data updated successfully.");
      fetchSurvey();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-xs text-slate-100">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <Network className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
          <span>DICT Annex A-1 (MITHI Survey Profiles)</span>
        </h2>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/30 text-red-300 rounded flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{typeof error === "object" ? error.message : error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {success && (
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-300 rounded flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-10 gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
            <span>Syncing database parameters...</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              {/* Network segment */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-850 space-y-4">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-850 pb-2">
                  <Network className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                  <span>Network Connectivity Survey</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-400">Local Area Network (LAN) presence</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasLan} onChange={(e) => setHasLan(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-400">Institutional Intranet Portal</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasIntranet} onChange={(e) => setHasIntranet(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-400">VPN Tunneling Capability</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasVpn} onChange={(e) => setHasVpn(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1.5">Combined Internet Bandwidth (Mbps)</label>
                  <input 
                    type="number" value={internetBandwidth} onChange={(e) => setInternetBandwidth(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. 50"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-blue-600 outline-none transition-all"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Data Center segment */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-850 space-y-4">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-850 pb-2">
                  <HardDrive className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span>Data Center Profile</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-400">On-Premise Physical Data Center</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasDataCenter} onChange={(e) => setHasDataCenter(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-emerald-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-400">Disaster Recovery (DR) Backup Site</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasBackupSite} onChange={(e) => setHasBackupSite(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-emerald-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1.5">Active Servers Count</label>
                  <input 
                    type="number" value={activeServersCount} onChange={(e) => setActiveServersCount(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. 2"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-blue-600 outline-none transition-all"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1.5">Maintenance Strategy</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" value={maintenanceStrategy} onChange={(e) => setMaintenanceStrategy(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-blue-600 outline-none transition-all"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit" disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Saving MITHI survey profiles...</span>

              ) : (
                <>

                  <span>Commit MITHI Survey Profiles</span>
