// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/NarrativeManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  FileText, Save, RefreshCw, CheckCircle, AlertCircle, 
  CalendarRange, Landmark, ShieldAlert, Settings2, FileSignature, Trash2 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function NarrativeManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, fetchActiveCycle } = useCycle();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("cycle"); 
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Dynamic Cycle Configuration State
  const [startYear, setStartYear] = useState("");
  const [endYear, setEndYear] = useState("");

  // Coversheet & Narrative Authorship State
  const [agencyName, setAgencyName] = useState("Camarines Sur Polytechnic Colleges");
  const [preparedBy, setPreparedBy] = useState("");
  const [approvedBy, setApprovedBy] = useState("");
  const [mandate, setMandate] = useState("");
  const [vision, setVision] = useState("");
  const [mission, setMission] = useState("");
  const [presentSituation, setPresentSituation] = useState("");

  // Letter of Transmittal Coversheet State
  const [recipientName, setRecipientName] = useState("ATTY. IVAN JOHN E. UY");
  const [recipientTitle, setRecipientTitle] = useState("Secretary");
  const [recipientAgency, setRecipientAgency] = useState("Department of Information and Communications Technology");
  const [recipientAddress, setRecipientAddress] = useState("DICT Bldg., C.P. Garcia Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City");
  const [transmittalDate, setTransmittalDate] = useState("");

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeCycle) {
      const parts = activeCycle.split("-");
      if (parts.length === 2) {
        setStartYear(parts[0]);
        setEndYear(parts[1]);
      }
    }
  }, [activeCycle]);

  const fetchCycleData = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setAgencyName(data.agency_name || "Camarines Sur Polytechnic Colleges");
        setPreparedBy(data.signatory_prepared_by || "");
        setApprovedBy(data.signatory_approved_by || "");
        setMandate(data.mandate_html || "");
        setVision(data.vision_html || "");
        setMission(data.mission_html || "");
        setPresentSituation(data.present_situation_html || "");
        setRecipientName(data.transmittal_recipient || "ATTY. IVAN JOHN E. UY");
        setRecipientTitle(data.transmittal_recipient_title || "Secretary");
        setRecipientAgency(data.transmittal_recipient_agency || "Department of Information and Communications Technology");
        setRecipientAddress(data.transmittal_recipient_address || "DICT Bldg., C.P. Garcia Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City");
        setTransmittalDate(data.transmittal_date || "");
      } else {
        setPreparedBy("");
        setApprovedBy("");
        setMandate("");
        setVision("");
        setMission("");
        setPresentSituation("");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Ready for cycle configuration.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchCycleData();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  const handleActivateCycle = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const start = parseInt(startYear, 10);
    const end = parseInt(endYear, 10);

    if (isNaN(start) || isNaN(end)) {
      setError("Please enter valid calendar years.");
      return;
    }

    if (start > end) {
      setError("Start Year must be less than or equal to End Year.");
      return;
    }

    const span = end - start + 1;
    if (span < 2 || span > 10) {
      setError(`ISSP cycles must span between 2 and 10 years. Currently requesting: ${span} years.`);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const targetCycle = `${start}-${end}`;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${targetCycle}/activate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to activate cycle.");
      }

      setSuccess(`Planning cycle updated and activated to: FY ${targetCycle}`);
      await fetchActiveCycle();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetCycle = async () => {
    const confirmation = window.confirm(
      `CRITICAL ACTION CONFIRMATION:\n` +
      `Are you sure you want to safe-reset the active cycle '${activeCycle}'?\n` +
      `This will completely purge all draft/submitted/approved proposals, dynamic narratives, and ceilings linked to this span.`
    );
    if (!confirmation) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}/reset`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to safe-reset planning cycle.");
      }

      setSuccess("Planning cycle metrics and templates safely purged. You can now define a corrected year span.");
      setStartYear("");
      setEndYear("");
      await fetchActiveCycle();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveNarratives = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          agency_name: agencyName.trim(),
          signatory_prepared_by: preparedBy.trim(),
          signatory_approved_by: approvedBy.trim(),
          mandate_html: mandate.trim(),
          vision_html: vision.trim(),
          mission_html: mission.trim(),
          present_situation_html: presentSituation.trim(),
          transmittal_recipient: recipientName.trim(),
          transmittal_recipient_title: recipientTitle.trim(),
          transmittal_recipient_agency: recipientAgency.trim(),
          transmittal_recipient_address: recipientAddress.trim(),
          transmittal_date: transmittalDate.trim(),
          issp_period_from: parseInt(startYear, 10),
          issp_period_to: parseInt(endYear, 10)
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to write narrative parameters.");
      }

      setSuccess("Coversheet narratives and transmittal fields saved successfully.");
      fetchCycleData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const calculatedSpan = parseInt(endYear, 10) - parseInt(startYear, 10) + 1;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Master ISSP Narrative and Coversheet Studio</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Centralized management of framework timelines, signatory coversheets, and legal compliance mandates.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{typeof error === "object" ? error.message : error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-955 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 self-start max-w-md">
        <button
          onClick={() => { setError(null); setSuccess(null); setActiveTab("cycle"); }}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "cycle" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
          }`}
        >
          <CalendarRange className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>1. Cycle & Signatories</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => { setError(null); setSuccess(null); setActiveTab("coversheet"); }}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "coversheet" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
          }`}
        >
          <FileSignature className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>2. Transmittal Letter</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => { setError(null); setSuccess(null); setActiveTab("parts"); }}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "parts" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
          }`}
        >
          <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>3. Mandates & Narratives</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {activeTab === "cycle" && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <form onSubmit={handleActivateCycle} className="space-y-4 animate-fadeIn">
                <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide border-b border-slate-855 pb-2">
                  Active Cycle Governance Configuration
                </h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      Start Fiscal Year
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      required
                      value={startYear}
                      onChange={(e) => setStartYear(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono text-center outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      End Fiscal Year
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      required
                      value={endYear}
                      onChange={(e) => setEndYear(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono text-center outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                {!isNaN(calculatedSpan) && calculatedSpan > 0 && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                    Calculated Duration: <span className="font-bold text-blue-400 font-mono">{calculatedSpan}-Year Planning Cycle</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Settings2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{submitting ? "Processing..." : "Activate Cycle Framework"}</span>
                </button>
              </form>

              {/* Cycle Safe Reset Control Panel */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-850/80 space-y-3.5 animate-fadeIn">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-200 block">Planning Cycle Reset Management</span>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                      Need to redefine active year spans or adjust the timeline plan? Running a Safe Reset transactionally flushes active drafts, narratives, and budget ceilings for '{activeCycle}' allowing you to establish a corrected cycle from scratch.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleResetCycle}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="p-2 px-4 bg-red-955 hover:bg-red-900 border border-red-900 text-red-300 font-bold rounded flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Safe Reset Active Cycle</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === "coversheet" && (
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveNarratives} className="space-y-4 animate-fadeIn">
              <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide border-b border-slate-855 pb-2">
                DICT Transmittal Coversheet Mappings
              </h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Recipient Full Name</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" required value={recipientName} onChange={(e) => setRecipientName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Recipient Title</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" required value={recipientTitle} onChange={(e) => setRecipientTitle(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Target Agency / Commission Name</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" required value={recipientAgency} onChange={(e) => setRecipientAgency(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Physical Delivery Address</label>
                <textarea 
                  rows={2} required value={recipientAddress} onChange={(e) => setRecipientAddress(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white resize-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Formal Document Date</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" required value={transmittalDate} onChange={(e) => setTransmittalDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="submit" disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : "Save Coversheet Parameters"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          {activeTab === "parts" && (
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveNarratives} className="space-y-4 animate-fadeIn">
              <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide border-b border-slate-855 pb-2">
                Mandates, Vision, & Mission Definitions
              </h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Signatory: Prepared By</label>
                  <input
                    type="text" required value={preparedBy} onChange={(e) => setPreparedBy(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                  />

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Signatory: Approved By</label>

                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Part I.A.1 - Legal Mandate (HTML Formatted)</label>
                <textarea
                  value={mandate} onChange={(e) => setMandate(e.target.value)} rows={3}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono text-[11px] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/PerformanceMetricsManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import {
  getPerformanceMetrics,
  createPerformanceMetric,
  deletePerformanceMetric
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Search,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  TrendingUp,
  Target,
  Database,
  User,
  GitBranch,
  Filter
} from "lucide-react";

export default function PerformanceMetricsManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    project_title: "",
    result_hierarchy: "Immediate outcome",
    indicator: "",
    baseline: "",
    target: "",
    collection_method: "",
    responsibility: ""
  });

  // Search & Filtering State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterHierarchy, setFilterHierarchy] = useState("All");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchMetricsList = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getPerformanceMetrics(user.token, activeCycle);
      setMetrics(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load Performance Measurement Framework metrics.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchMetricsList();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.project_title.trim()) return "Associated Project Title is required.";
    if (!form.indicator.trim()) return "Verifiable Indicator description is required.";
    if (!form.baseline.trim()) return "Baseline benchmarking data is required.";
    if (!form.target.trim()) return "Target outcome description is required.";
    if (!form.collection_method.trim()) return "Data collection method is required.";
    if (!form.responsibility.trim()) return "Responsible SUC office/unit is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        project_title: form.project_title.trim(),
        result_hierarchy: form.result_hierarchy,
        indicator: form.indicator.trim(),
        baseline: form.baseline.trim(),
        target: form.target.trim(),
        collection_method: form.collection_method.trim(),
        responsibility: form.responsibility.trim()
      };

      await createPerformanceMetric(user.token, activeCycle, payload);
      setSuccess("Performance indicator documented successfully.");

      // Reset form (except project_title to assist in multi-metric registering)
      setForm(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        indicator: "",
        baseline: "",
        target: "",
        collection_method: "",
        responsibility: ""
      }));
      fetchMetricsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save framework metric.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this performance metric from the framework?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deletePerformanceMetric(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Framework metric removed successfully.");
      fetchMetricsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete framework metric.");
    }
  };

  const filteredMetrics = metrics.filter(m => {
    const matchesSearch = 
      m.project_title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      m.indicator.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      m.responsibility.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    
    const matchesHierarchy = filterHierarchy === "All" || m.result_hierarchy === filterHierarchy;

    return matchesSearch && matchesHierarchy;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Part III.C: Performance Measurement Framework (PMF)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Configure and manage performance indicators, outcome targets, data audits, and responsible units for all standard projects.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-900 rounded font-bold font-mono text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Cycle: {activeCycle || "Unassigned"}
        </span>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Metric Form Registration */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Register Framework Metric</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Associated Project Title</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Deployment of Moodle LMS"
              value={form.project_title}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, project_title: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-semibold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">PMF Result Hierarchy</label>
            <select
              value={form.result_hierarchy}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, result_hierarchy: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="Immediate outcome">Immediate outcome</option>
              <option value="Intermediate outcome">Intermediate outcome</option>
              <option value="Outputs">Outputs</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Verifiable Indicator (OVI)</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Percentage of courses active inside LMS"
              value={form.indicator}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, indicator: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Baseline Data</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. 10% adoption"
                value={form.baseline}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, baseline: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Target Outcome</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. 100% adoption"
                value={form.target}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, target: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Collection Method / Data Source</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. LMS system logs audits"
              value={form.collection_method}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, collection_method: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">SUC Responsibility Unit</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. MICT Office / Deans"
              value={form.responsibility}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, responsibility: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
          >
            <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : "Save PMF Metric"}</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Framework Grid Display */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Controls Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search projects or indicators..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-auto">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Hierarchy:</span>
              <div className="flex bg-slate-950 rounded-lg p-0.5 border border-slate-850">
                {["All", "Immediate outcome", "Intermediate outcome", "Outputs"].map(h => (
                  <button
                    key={h}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterHierarchy(h)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[9px] font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterHierarchy === h 
                        ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white" 
                        : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {h === "All" ? "All" : h.split(" ")[0]}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Table display */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-indigo-500" />
                <span>Reading PMF framework listings...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredMetrics.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-[22%]">Project Title</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-[15%]">Hierarchy</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-[25%]">Indicator (OVI)</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 w-[25%]">Target vs Baseline</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredMetrics.map(m => (
                    <tr key={m.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors text-[11px]">
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-slate-200">{m.project_title}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold tracking-wide uppercase ${
                          m.result_hierarchy === "Outputs"
                            ? "bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-850 text-blue-300"
                            : m.result_hierarchy === "Intermediate outcome"
                            ? "bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-850 text-purple-300"
                            : "bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-850 text-indigo-300"
                        }`}>
                          {m.result_hierarchy.replace(" outcome", "")}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-slate-300 leading-relaxed break-words">{m.indicator}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 space-y-1.5 font-mono">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs">
                          <Target className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                          <span>Tgt: {m.target}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400 text-[10px]">
                          <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 shrink-0" />
                          <span>Base: {m.baseline}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-500 text-[10px]">
                          <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 shrink-0" />
                          <span className="font-sans">Resp: {m.responsibility}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(m.id)}
                          className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Purge Metric"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No matching performance target metrics logged for cycle period '{activeCycle}'.
              </div>
            )}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/StaffPositionsManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import {
  getStaffPositions,
  createStaffPosition,
  updateStaffPosition,
  deleteStaffPosition
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Users,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit3,
  Save,
  X,
  RefreshCw,
  Hash,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  Briefcase,
  Layers
} from "lucide-react";

export default function StaffPositionsManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [positions, setPositions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  // Notification states
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    position_title: "",
    status: "Permanent",
    count: 1
  });

  // Inline Edit State
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({
    position_title: "",
    status: "Permanent",
    count: 1
  });

  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchPositions = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle || !token) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getStaffPositions(token, activeCycle);
      setPositions(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load IT staff positions.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchPositions();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (!form.position_title.trim()) {
      setError("Position title is required.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        position_title: form.position_title.trim(),
        status: form.status,
        count: parseInt(form.count, 10) || 1
      };
      await createStaffPosition(token, activeCycle, payload);
      setSuccess("Staff position registered successfully.");
      setForm({ position_title: "", status: "Permanent", count: 1 });
      fetchPositions();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to register staff position.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (pos) => {
    setEditingId(pos.id);
    setEditForm({
      position_title: pos.position_title,
      status: pos.status,
      count: pos.count
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setEditForm({ position_title: "", status: "Permanent", count: 1 });
  };

  const handleUpdate = async (e, id) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const payload = {
        position_title: editForm.position_title.trim(),
        status: editForm.status,
        count: parseInt(editForm.count, 10) || 1
      };
      await updateStaffPosition(token, id, payload);
      setSuccess("Staff position updated successfully.");
      setEditingId(null);
      fetchPositions();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update staff position.");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this staff position?")) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteStaffPosition(token, id);
      setSuccess("Staff position successfully removed.");
      fetchPositions();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete staff position.");
    }
  };

  const totalHeadcount = positions.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.count || 0), 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Part IV.B: SUC IT Staffing Registry</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Track active staffing positions, classifications, and headcounts to fulfill compliance reporting requirements.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-slate-950 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          <div className="text-right">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Total Headcount:</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold text-sm">{totalHeadcount.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Creator Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Document New Position</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Official Position Title</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Database Administrator"
              value={form.position_title}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, position_title: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Status Classification</label>
            <select
              value={form.status}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, status: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="Permanent">Permanent</option>
              <option value="Contractual">Contractual</option>
              <option value="Casual">Casual</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Total Headcount</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min="0"
                placeholder="1"
                value={form.count}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, count: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1 })}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono font-bold"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all pt-2.5"
          >
            <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Documenting..." : "Save Position"}</span>
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Directory Output */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800 pb-2 mb-4">
            IT Staffing Registry List
          </h3>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading staff registry...</span>
              </div>
            ) : positions.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 w-2/5">Position Title</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 w-1/4">Status</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 w-1/5">Count</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/40">
                  {positions.map(pos => (
                    <tr key={pos.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/25 transition-colors">
                      {editingId === pos.id ? (
                        <td colSpan={4} className="py-3 px-2">
                          <form onSubmit={(e) => handleUpdate(e, pos.id)} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 items-center">
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={editForm.position_title}
                              onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, position_title: e.target.value })}
                              className="p-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white"
                              required
                            />
                            <select
                              value={editForm.status}
                              onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, status: e.target.value })}
                              className="p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <option value="Permanent">Permanent</option>
                              <option value="Contractual">Contractual</option>
                              <option value="Casual">Casual</option>
                            </select>
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={editForm.count}
                              onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, count: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1 })}
                              className="p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white font-mono"
                              required
                            />
                            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                              <button 
                                type="submit" 
                                className="p-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Save changes"
                              >
                                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button 
                                type="button" 
                                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                                className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Cancel"
                              >
                                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </form>
                        </td>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 font-bold text-slate-200">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                              <span>{pos.position_title}</span>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2">
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-950/40 px-2.5 py-1 border border-slate-850 rounded text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-blue-400">
                              {pos.status}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 font-mono font-bold text-blue-400">{pos.count}</td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-2 text-right">
                            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleStartEdit(pos)}
                                className="p-1.5 hover:text-blue-400 text-slate-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Edit properties"
                              >
                                <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(pos.id)}
                                className="p-1.5 hover:text-red-400 text-slate-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Purge staff position record"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500 italic">
                No staffing positions recorded. Document active staff members using the configuration form.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/StrategicConcernsManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import {
  getStrategicConcerns,
  createStrategicConcern,
  updateStrategicConcern,
  deleteStrategicConcern
} from "../../../api/admin";
import {
  Save,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit,
  Search,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  ShieldAlert,
  Cpu,
  CornerDownRight
} from "lucide-react";

export default function StrategicConcernsManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [concerns, setConcerns] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    mfo: "",
    critical_system: "",
    problems: "",
    intended_use: ""
  });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  // Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchConcernsList = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getStrategicConcerns(user.token, activeCycle);
      setConcerns(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load strategic concerns matrix.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchConcernsList();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.mfo.trim()) return "Major Final Output / Key Result Area description is required.";
    if (!form.critical_system.trim()) return "Critical SUC Business System description is required.";
    if (!form.problems.trim()) return "At least one descriptive problem entry is required.";
    if (!form.intended_use.trim()) return "Intended use of ICT solution description is required.";
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        mfo: form.mfo.trim(),
        critical_system: form.critical_system.trim(),
        problems: form.problems.trim(),
        intended_use: form.intended_use.trim()
      };

      if (editId) {
        await updateStrategicConcern(user.token, editId, payload);
        setSuccess("Strategic concern updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createStrategicConcern(user.token, activeCycle, payload);
        setSuccess("Strategic concern documented successfully.");
      }

      // Reset form
      setForm({
        mfo: "",
        critical_system: "",
        problems: "",
        intended_use: ""
      });
      setEditId(null);
      fetchConcernsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save strategic concern record.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (c) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditId(c.id);
    setForm({
      mfo: c.mfo,
      critical_system: c.critical_system,
      problems: c.problems,
      intended_use: c.intended_use
    });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setForm({
      mfo: "",
      critical_system: "",
      problems: "",
      intended_use: ""
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this strategic concern record?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteStrategicConcern(user.token, id);
      setSuccess("Strategic concern successfully purged.");
      fetchConcernsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete strategic concern entry.");
    }
  };

  const filteredConcerns = concerns.filter(c =>
    c.mfo.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    c.critical_system.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    c.problems.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
    c.intended_use.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Title Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Part I.E: SUC Strategic Concerns Matrix</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Map Key Result Areas to business workflows and establish the intended use of proposed ICT solutions.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-900 rounded font-bold font-mono text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Cycle: {activeCycle || "Unassigned"}
        </span>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Editor Form Panel */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            {editId ? <Edit className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />}
            <span>{editId ? "Update Strategic Concern" : "Document Strategic Concern"}</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Major Final Output / KRA</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Higher Education Services"
              value={form.mfo}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, mfo: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-semibold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Critical SUC Business System</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Student Information & Accounting System"
              value={form.critical_system}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, critical_system: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Problems Encountered</label>
            <textarea
              placeholder="Descriptive explanation of performance latencies or workflow bottlenecks..."
              value={form.problems}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, problems: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white h-24 resize-none leading-relaxed"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Intended Use of ICT Solution</label>
            <textarea
              placeholder="How the proposed hardware, software, or network pipeline will resolve the problem..."
              value={form.intended_use}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, intended_use: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white h-24 resize-none leading-relaxed"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            {editId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cancel
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className={`py-2.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                editId 
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 w-2/3" 
                  : "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 w-full"
              }`}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : editId ? "Update Concern" : "Save Concern"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Matrix Registry Display */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          
          {/* Controls */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 border-b border-slate-850 pb-4">
            <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-500">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search concerns or business systems..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-slate-500 text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Table list */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <ShieldAlert className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2 text-indigo-500" />
                <span>Reading strategic concerns matrix...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredConcerns.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[600px] pr-2">
                {filteredConcerns.map(c => (
                  <div key={c.id} className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 p-4 rounded-xl space-y-3 hover:border-indigo-900 transition-all">
                    
                    {/* Header bar */}
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-indigo-950/40 px-2 py-0.5 border border-indigo-900 rounded">
                          KRA: {c.mfo}
                        </span>
                        <h4 className="text-slate-200 font-bold mt-1.5 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Cpu className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                          <span>{c.critical_system}</span>
                        </h4>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleEdit(c)}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-850 rounded border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Edit Concern"
                        >
                          <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-850 rounded border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Purge Concern"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Breakdown grids */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2 border-t border-slate-850 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-red-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-[9px] block">Problems Encountered:</span>
                        <p className="text-slate-400 italic break-words">{c.problems}</p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-[9px] flex items-center gap-0.5">
                          <CornerDownRight className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-500" />
                          <span>Intended ICT Solution:</span>
                        </span>
                        <p className="text-slate-400 break-words">{c.intended_use}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">
                No strategic concerns logged for cycle period '{activeCycle}'.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/TransmittalLetterPreview.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  Save, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle,
  FileText,
  Mail,
  User,
  MapPin,
  Calendar
} from "lucide-react";

export default function TransmittalLetterPreview() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  
  // Transmittal configuration state
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    transmittal_recipient: "",
    transmittal_recipient_title: "",
    transmittal_recipient_agency: "",
    transmittal_recipient_address: "",
    transmittal_date: "",
    signatory_approved_by: ""
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiEndpoint = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;

  const fetchTransmittalDetails = async () => {
    if (!activeCycle) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to load SUC transmittal details.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      setForm({
        transmittal_recipient: data.transmittal_recipient || "",
        transmittal_recipient_title: data.transmittal_recipient_title || "",
        transmittal_recipient_agency: data.transmittal_recipient_agency || "",
        transmittal_recipient_address: data.transmittal_recipient_address || "",
        transmittal_date: data.transmittal_date || "",
        signatory_approved_by: data.signatory_approved_by || ""
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to retrieve transmittal configurations.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && activeCycle) {
      fetchTransmittalDetails();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/narratives/${activeCycle}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(form)
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to preserve transmittal letter metadata.");
      }

      setSuccess("Transmittal letter layout configurations updated successfully.");
      fetchTransmittalDetails();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update transmittal parameters.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
            <span>Letter of Transmittal Layout Configurator</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">Configure formal recipient lines, addresses, dates, and preview formatting styles.</p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchTransmittalDetails}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          title="Refresh Metadata"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 items-start">
        {/* Editor Form Panel */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
            <span>Transmittal Address Settings</span>
          </h3>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
              <User className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Recipient Name</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Director General, DICT"
              value={form.transmittal_recipient}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, transmittal_recipient: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                placeholder="e.g. Regional Director"
                value={form.transmittal_recipient_title}
                onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, transmittal_recipient_title: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-855 rounded-lg text-white"

              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
              <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Agency Address</span>

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\admin\Queue\ConsolidatedQueue.jsx
