// frontend/src/views/admin/Queue/ConsolidatedQueue.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { getComments, postComment, resolveComment } from "../../../api/dept";
import StatusPill from "../../../components/common/StatusPill";
import { 
  ShieldCheck, FileText, FolderKanban, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, 
  Search, Check, RotateCcw, Edit, MessageSquare, ExternalLink, HardDrive, CheckSquare
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ConsolidatedQueue() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, planningYears } = useCycle();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("capex"); // capex or mooe
  const [proposals, setProposals] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Filters
  const [deptFilter, setDeptFilter] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("");

  // Override Modal State
  const [activeOverrideItem, setActiveOverrideItem] = useState(null);
  const [overrideItemName, setOverrideItemName] = useState("");
  const [overrideUnitCost, setOverrideUnitCost] = useState("");
  const [overrideQuantities, setOverrideQuantities] = useState({});
  const [overrideSpec, setOverrideSpec] = useState("");
  const [overrideOffices, setOverrideOffices] = useState("");
  const [submittingOverride, setSubmittingOverride] = useState(false);

  // Comments / Remarks Thread Modal State
  const [activeDiscussionItem, setActiveDiscussionItem] = useState(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [newCommentText, setNewCommentText] = useState("");
  const [requiresAction, setRequiresAction] = useState(false);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken;

  // Department ID static label translation map
  const getDeptName = (id) => {
    const depts = {
      1: "College of Engineering",
      2: "College of Computer Studies",
      3: "College of Arts & Sciences",
      4: "Human Resources Management"
    };
    return depts[id] || `Department ID: ${id}`;
  };

  const fetchQueue = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      let queryParams = `?skip=0&limit=1000`;
      if (deptFilter) queryParams += `&dept_id=${deptFilter}`;
      if (statusFilter) queryParams += `&status_filter=${statusFilter}`;

      if (activeTab === "capex") {
        const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals${queryParams}`, {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load CapEx hardware queue.");
        const data = await res.json();
        setProposals(data);
      } else {
        const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/subscriptions${queryParams}`, {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load MOOE subscriptions queue.");
        const data = await res.json();
        setProposals(data); // Shared state container
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchQueue();
    }
  }, [token, activeTab, deptFilter, statusFilter, activeCycle]);

  // Transition: SUBMITTED -> APPROVED
  const handleApprove = async (id, itemName) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/${id}/approve`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Approval transition rejected.");
      }
      setSuccess(`Proposal '${itemName}' approved successfully.`);
      fetchQueue();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  // Transition: SUBMITTED -> RETURNED
  const handleReturn = async (id, itemName) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/${id}/return`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Return transition rejected.");
      }
      setSuccess(`Proposal '${itemName}' successfully returned to department drafts.`);
      fetchQueue();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  // Polymorphic Administrative Override modal configuration
  const openOverrideModal = (item) => {
    setActiveOverrideItem(item);
    setOverrideItemName(item.item_name || item.software_name || "");
    setOverrideUnitCost(String(item.unit_cost || item.annual_cost_per_user || "0"));
    setOverrideSpec(item.custom_specification || item.justification || "");
    setOverrideOffices(item.target_offices_json ? item.target_offices_json.join(", ") : "");
    
    // Prefill quantities/users map based on active years
    const currentQuantities = item.yearly_quantities || item.yearly_users || {};
    const prefill = {};
    planningYears.forEach(year => {
      prefill[String(year)] = currentQuantities[String(year)] || 0;
    });
    setOverrideQuantities(prefill);
  };

  const handleSaveOverride = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmittingOverride(true);

    const parsedOffices = overrideOffices
      ? overrideOffices.split(",").map(o => o.trim()).filter(o => o.length > 0)
      : [];

    let payload = {};
    if (activeTab === "capex") {
      payload = {
        hardware: {
          item_name: overrideItemName,
          custom_specification: overrideSpec,
          unit_cost: parseFloat(overrideUnitCost) || 0.0,
          yearly_quantities: overrideQuantities,
          target_offices_json: parsedOffices
        }
      };
    } else {
      payload = {
        subscription: {
          software_name: overrideItemName,
          justification: overrideSpec,
          annual_cost_per_user: parseFloat(overrideUnitCost) || 0.0,
          yearly_users: overrideQuantities,
          target_offices_json: parsedOffices
        }
      };
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals/${activeOverrideItem.id}/override`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Override parameters violated budget bounds.");
      }

      setSuccess(`Administrative override committed successfully for: ${overrideItemName}`);
      setActiveOverrideItem(null);
      fetchQueue();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmittingOverride(false);
    }
  };

  const openComments = async (item) => {
    setActiveDiscussionItem(item);
    setNewCommentText("");
    setRequiresAction(false);
    try {
      const data = await getComments(item.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handlePostComment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newCommentText.trim()) return;
    try {
      await postComment(activeDiscussionItem.id, {
        text: newCommentText.trim(),
        requires_department_action: requiresAction
      });
      setNewCommentText("");
      setRequiresAction(false);
      const data = await getComments(activeDiscussionItem.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleResolveComment = async (commentId) => {
    try {
      await resolveComment(activeDiscussionItem.id, commentId);
      const data = await getComments(activeDiscussionItem.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto text-xs text-slate-100">
      {/* Page Title */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Master Consolidation Queue Panel</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Consolidate, audit, and override hardware and software subscriptions submitted across all college departments.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchQueue}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Workspace</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Segmented Queue View Tabs & Filters */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 justify-between items-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-850">
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-950 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 self-start">
          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab("capex"); setProposals([]); }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
              activeTab === "capex" 
                ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" 
                : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
            }`}
          >
            <FolderKanban className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>CapEx Hardware (A-6)</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab("mooe"); setProposals([]); }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
              activeTab === "mooe" 
                ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white" 
                : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
            }`}
          >
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>MOOE Subscriptions (A-2)</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
          <select
            value={deptFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setDeptFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="p-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded text-slate-300 font-semibold cursor-pointer outline-none w-full md:w-44"
          >
            <option value="">-- All Departments --</option>
            <option value="1">College of Engineering</option>
            <option value="2">College of Computer Studies</option>
            <option value="3">College of Arts & Sciences</option>
            <option value="4">Human Resources Management</option>
          </select>

          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="p-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded text-slate-300 font-semibold cursor-pointer outline-none w-full md:w-40"
          >
            <option value="">-- All Statuses --</option>
            <option value="Submitted">Submitted</option>
            <option value="Approved">Approved</option>
            <option value="Returned">Returned</option>
            <option value="Draft">Draft</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Table Container */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-2 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
              <span>Fetching dynamic queue records...</span>
            </div>
          ) : proposals.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/40 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Department</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Requested Resource</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Planning Years Target</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Unit Cost / Price</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Quotation</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                {proposals.map((item) => {
                  const isCapEx = activeTab === "capex";
                  const label = isCapEx ? item.item_name : item.software_name;
                  const itemSpec = isCapEx ? item.custom_specification : item.justification;
                  const unitCostVal = isCapEx ? item.unit_cost : item.annual_cost_per_user;
                  const totalMetric = isCapEx ? `${item.total_qty} units` : `₱${parseFloat(item.total_multiyear_mooe).toLocaleString()} MOOE`;
                  const filename = item.canvas_evidence_url ? item.canvas_evidence_url.split("/").pop() : null;

                  return (
                    <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/20 transition-all">
                      {/* Department Tag */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                        <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-[4px] text-[10px] font-bold bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-900/60 text-blue-400">
                          {getDeptName(item.department_id)}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Item Details */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-200">{label}</div>
                        {itemSpec && (
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 italic max-w-[200px] truncate mt-0.5" title={itemSpec}>
                            {itemSpec}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Multi-Year Timeline Breakdown */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-300">{totalMetric}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                          {planningYears.map(year => {
                            const val = isCapEx ? item.yearly_quantities?.[String(year)] : item.yearly_users?.[String(year)];
                            return `FY ${year}: ${val || 0}`;
                          }).join(" | ")}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Unit Price */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3 font-mono text-slate-200">
                        ₱{parseFloat(unitCostVal).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>

                      {/* Linked Quotation & Storage S3 Class */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                        {item.canvas_evidence_url ? (
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <a
                              href={item.canvas_evidence_url}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              className="text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5"
                            >
                              <span>Proof</span>
                              <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                            </a>
                            {item.s3_storage_class && (
                              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono flex items-center gap-0.5">
                                <HardDrive className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                <span>{item.s3_storage_class}</span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-rose-500 italic font-bold">Missing</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Status Badging */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3">
                        <StatusPill status={item.status} />
                      </td>

                      {/* Inline Actions Toolbar */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => openComments(item)}
                            className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded border border-slate-850 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                            title="Remarks & Thread Comments"
                          >
                            <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>

                          {item.status === "Submitted" ? (
                            <>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleApprove(item.id, label)}
                                className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-emerald-950/50 text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-400 rounded border border-slate-850 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                title="Approve compliance entry"
                              >
                                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => openOverrideModal(item)}
                                className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-purple-950/50 text-slate-400 hover:text-purple-400 rounded border border-slate-850 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                title="Administrative Override"
                              >
                                <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleReturn(item.id, label)}
                                className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-red-955/50 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 rounded border border-slate-850 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                title="Return to department drafts"
                              >
                                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide self-center px-1">
                              Locked
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500">
              The queue is currently empty. No proposals match the active search filters.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Polymorphic Override Modal */}
      {activeOverrideItem && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-955/75 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm">Administrative Override Console</h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setActiveOverrideItem(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-lg"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveOverride} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Overridden Product Label
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={overrideItemName}
                  onChange={(e) => setOverrideItemName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Overridden Unit Cost (PHP)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="0.01"
                    required
                    value={overrideUnitCost}
                    onChange={(e) => setOverrideUnitCost(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Deployments Target Scope (CSV)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={overrideOffices}
                    onChange={(e) => setOverrideOffices(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Quantities / Users multi-year target grids */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5 p-3 bg-slate-950 rounded-lg border border-slate-850">
                <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">
                  Adjust Multi-Year Target Capacities
                </span>
                {planningYears.map(year => (
                  <div key={year} className="flex justify-between items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-400 font-mono">FY {year} Scope</span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      required
                      value={overrideQuantities[String(year)] || 0}
                      onChange={(e) => setOverrideQuantities({
                        ...overrideQuantities,
                        [String(year)]: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                      })}
                      className="w-24 p-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-center text-white font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Overridden Narrative Justification / Specifications
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={overrideSpec}
                  onChange={(e) => setOverrideSpec(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submittingOverride}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all"
              >
                <span>{submittingOverride ? "Commiting overrides..." : "Commit Administrative Override"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Discussion & Collaborative Comments Modal */}
      {activeDiscussionItem && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-xl flex flex-col h-[520px]">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-950/50 rounded-t-xl">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-sm">Discussions & Revision Remarks</h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Resource ID: {activeDiscussionItem.id}</p>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setActiveDiscussionItem(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-lg font-bold"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Thread feed */}
            <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 font-sans text-xs">
              {comments.length > 0 ? (
                comments.map((comment) => (
                  <div key={comment.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
                      <span className="font-bold text-blue-400">{comment.author_name}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-500">{new Date(comment.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">{comment.text}</p>
                    
                    {comment.requires_department_action && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex justify-between items-center">
                        <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-950/40 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Requires Dept Action
                        </span>
                        {comment.is_resolved ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px]">
                            <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Resolved
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleResolveComment(comment.id)}
                            className="text-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Resolve Action
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500">
                  No discussion remarks logged yet. Pinned admin feedback will render here.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Post comment form */}
            <form onSubmit={handlePostComment} className="p-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-955 rounded-b-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  id="action_gate"
                  checked={requiresAction}
                  onChange={(e) => setRequiresAction(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-red-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                />
                <label htmlFor="action_gate" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer">
                  Flag as Action Item (submission lock gate)
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={newCommentText}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCommentText(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Type an inline revision remark or comment..."
                  className="flex-1 p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded text-xs text-white outline-none"
                />
                <button 
                  type="submit"
                  className="p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Post Remark
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/admin/Users/UserWhitelisting.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { 
  UserPlus, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Shield, 
  Plus, Trash2, Landmark, Edit2, Key, Save, X 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function UserWhitelisting() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  
  // Whitelist States
  const [whitelist, setWhitelist] = useState([]);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState("ROLE_DEPT_USER");
  const [deptId, setDeptId] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  // Department Management States
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [newDeptName, setNewDeptName] = useState("");
  const [creatingDept, setCreatingDept] = useState(false);

  // Global Notification States
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // EDIT MODAL STATES: USER
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState(null);
  const [editEmail, setEditEmail] = useState("");
  const [editPassword, setEditPassword] = useState("");
  const [editRole, setEditRole] = useState("ROLE_DEPT_USER");
  const [editDeptId, setEditDeptId] = useState("");

  // EDIT MODAL STATES: DEPARTMENT
  const [editingDept, setEditingDept] = useState(null);
  const [editDeptName, setEditDeptName] = useState("");

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const handleFetchError = async (res, url, customContextMessage) => {
    let errorDetail = "No detailed error payload returned from the server.";
    let rawBody = "";
    
    try {
      rawBody = await res.text();
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawBody);
      errorDetail = parsed.detail || JSON.stringify(parsed);
    } catch (e) {
      errorDetail = rawBody || `HTTP status code ${res.status}`;
    }

    const formattedDetail = typeof errorDetail === "string" ? errorDetail : JSON.stringify(errorDetail);

    return {
      context: customContextMessage,
      message: formattedDetail,
      url: url,
      status: res.status
    };
  };

  const fetchDepartments = async () => {
    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setDepartments(data);
        if (data.length > 0 && !deptId) {
          setDeptId(String(data[0].department_id));
        }
      } else {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to load departments registry");
        setError(errorObj);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: e.message || "Failed to query the departments endpoint.",
        url: targetUrl
      });
    }
  };

  const fetchWhitelist = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setWhitelist(data);
      } else {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to query whitelisted users pool");
        setError(errorObj);
        setWhitelist([]); 
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: e.message || "Is the backend server running?",
        url: targetUrl
      });
      setWhitelist([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchDepartments();
      fetchWhitelist();
    }
  }, [token]);

  // CREATE USER
  const handleAddUser = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (!email.toLowerCase().endsWith("@cspc.edu.ph")) {
      setError({
        context: "Compliance Check Blocked",
        message: "Institutional accounts must reside strictly under the @cspc.edu.ph domain space."
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
          password: password.trim() || null,
          assigned_department_id: role === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? null : parseInt(deptId, 10),
          role_tag: role
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to whitelist target user account");
        setError(errorObj);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Account '${email}' has been whitelisted and linked successfully.`);
        setEmail("");
        setPassword(""); 
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: err.message,
        url: targetUrl
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // UPDATE USER
  const openEditUserModal = (u) => {
    setEditingUser(u);
    setEditEmail(u.email);
    setEditRole(u.role_tag);
    setEditDeptId(u.department_id ? String(u.department_id) : "");
    setEditPassword("");
  };

  const handleUpdateUser = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist/${editingUser.id}`;
    const payload = {
      email: editEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),
      role_tag: editRole,
      assigned_department_id: editRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? 0 : parseInt(editDeptId, 10)
    };

    if (editPassword.trim()) {
      payload.password = editPassword.trim();
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to update user profile");
        setError(errorObj);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Successfully updated profile details for '${editEmail}'.`);
        setEditingUser(null);
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: err.message,
        url: targetUrl
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // DELETE USER
  const handleDeleteUser = async (userId, userEmail) => {
    if (userEmail === user?.email) {
      setError({
        context: "Administrative Guard Block",
        message: "You are prohibited from removing your active administrative account session."
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(`Confirm: Delete whitelisted account '${userEmail}'?`)) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist/${userId}`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to delete whitelisted user");
        setError(errorObj);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Account '${userEmail}' purged successfully.`);
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: err.message,
        url: targetUrl
      });
    }
  };

  // CREATE DEPARTMENT
  const handleCreateDepartment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newDeptName.trim()) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setCreatingDept(true);

    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: newDeptName.trim() })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to create department");
        setError(errorObj);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Department '${newDeptName.trim()}' added successfully to active registry.`);
        setNewDeptName("");
        await fetchDepartments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: err.message,
        url: targetUrl
      });
    } finally {
      setCreatingDept(false);
    }
  };

  // UPDATE DEPARTMENT
  const openEditDeptModal = (dept) => {
    setEditingDept(dept);
    setEditDeptName(dept.department_name);
  };

  const handleUpdateDepartment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setCreatingDept(true);

    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments/${editingDept.department_id}`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: editDeptName.trim() })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to update department details");
        setError(errorObj);
      } else {
        setSuccess("Department designation updated successfully.");
        setEditingDept(null);
        setEditDeptName("");
        fetchDepartments();
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: err.message,
        url: targetUrl
      });
    } finally {
      setCreatingDept(false);
    }
  };

  // DELETE DEPARTMENT
  const handleDeleteDepartment = async (id, name) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete the department '${name}'?`)) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    const targetUrl = `${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments/${id}`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorObj = await handleFetchError(res, targetUrl, "Failed to delete department");
        setError(errorObj);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Department '${name}' removed successfully from active registry.`);
        await fetchDepartments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError({
        context: "Network Connection Failure",
        message: err.message,
        url: targetUrl
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto text-slate-100 select-none">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>CSPC Domain Whitelist & Onboarding Control</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Pre-authorize @cspc.edu.ph institutional emails and manage dynamic college divisions.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchWhitelist}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Refresh Queue</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-5 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900/60 text-red-300 rounded-xl space-y-3 text-xs leading-relaxed">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-400 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200 block text-sm">
                {error.context || "Operation Failure Intercepted"}
              </span>
              <p className="text-red-300 font-medium">
                {error.message}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Creator Form Box */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <UserPlus className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Register Whitelist</span>
            </h3>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleAddUser} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Official Institutional Email Address
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="account@cspc.edu.ph"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Initial Local Password (Optional)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Min 8 characters (Optional)"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Assigned Operational Role
                </label>
                <select
                  value={role}
                  onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="ROLE_DEPT_USER" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Department User (Draft, Submissions)</option>
                  <option value="ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">MIS Admin (Governance, Whitelist)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {role !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Linked Institutional Department Mapping
                  </label>
                  {departments.length > 0 ? (
                    <select
                      value={deptId}
                      onChange={(e) => setDeptId(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {departments.map((dept) => (
                        <option key={dept.department_id} value={String(dept.department_id)} className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">
                          {dept.department_name} (ID: {dept.department_id})
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-slate-500 italic block text-[10px] bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded border border-slate-850">
                      Please register a department division first.
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting || (role !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && departments.length === 0)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <UserPlus className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
                <span>{submitting ? "Processing..." : "Whitelist Account"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Department Registry CRUD Control Panel */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Landmark className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-purple-500" />
              <span>College Division Registry</span>
            </h3>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateDepartment} className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={newDeptName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewDeptName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Office of Academic Affairs"
                className="flex-1 p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-xs text-white outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={creatingDept}
                className="p-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white rounded font-bold shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{creatingDept ? "Saving..." : "Add"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>

            <div className="max-h-44 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pt-2">
              {departments.map((dept) => (
                <div key={dept.department_id} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-955 p-2 rounded border border-slate-850 text-xs">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300">{dept.department_name}</span>
                  <div className="flex gap-1">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => openEditDeptModal(dept)}
                      className="p-1 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Edit Department Name"
                    >
                      <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDeleteDepartment(dept.department_id, dept.department_name)}
                      className="p-1 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-red-955 border border-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Delete Department"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Data List Display Container */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase">
              Authorized Institutional Users Pool
            </h3>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 font-mono">
              Total Accounts: {whitelist.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 gap-2 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
                <span>Loading authorized users...</span>
              </div>
            ) : whitelist.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Institutional Email</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Department Assignment</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2">Access Rank</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800">
                  {whitelist.map((item) => (
                    <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/30 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 font-semibold text-slate-200 font-mono">{item.email}</td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-slate-400">
                        {item.department_name || "Global Admin"}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                        <span className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider ${
                          item.role_tag === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" 
                            ? "bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-800/60 text-purple-400" 
                            : "bg-blue-950/40 border-blue-800/60 text-blue-400"
                        }`}>
                          {item.role_tag === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? "Admin" : "Dept User"}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => openEditUserModal(item)}
                            className="p-1 bg-slate-955 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            title="Edit User Parameters"
                          >
                            <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteUser(item.id, item.email)}
                            className="p-1 bg-slate-955 hover:bg-red-955 border border-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            title="Remove User"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                No users have been pre-whitelisted yet. Pre-authorize an email address to begin onboarding.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* USER EDIT MODAL */}
      {editingUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm">Edit User Parameters</h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setEditingUser(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-lg cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleUpdateUser} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Institutional Email Address
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={editEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Rotate Password (Leave blank to keep current)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={editPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter new password (Min 8 chars)"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Access Rank Role
                </label>
                <select
                  value={editRole}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="ROLE_DEPT_USER" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Department User</option>
                  <option value="ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">MIS Admin</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {editRole !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Department Mapping
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={editDeptId}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditDeptId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Unassociated</option>
                    {departments.map((dept) => (
                      <option key={dept.department_id} value={String(dept.department_id)} className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">
                        {dept.department_name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{submitting ? "Saving changes..." : "Save User Parameters"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* DEPARTMENT EDIT MODAL */}
      {editingDept && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-955/75 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-sm p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm">Edit Department Name</h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setEditingDept(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-lg cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleUpdateDepartment} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Department Name Designation
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={editDeptName}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditDeptName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={creatingDept}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{creatingDept ? "Updating..." : "Update Department"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/auth/Login.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { login } from '../../api/auth';
import { Lock } from 'lucide-react';

export default function Login() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { loginSession } = useAuth();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  // Initialize with blank defaults to enforce secure user input
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Connect to the backend to authenticate credentials against target storage
      const data = await login(email, password);
      
      // Register session variables
      loginSession(data.access_token, data.role, data.department_id);

      // Route directly to unified dashboard pathway where roles are parsed
      if (data.role === 'ROLE_MIS_ADMIN' || data.role === 'ROLE_DEPT_USER') {
        navigate('/dashboard');
      } else {
        setError('Unauthorized role allocation.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // General error message to prevent account enumeration vectors
      setError('Invalid institutional credentials.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogleAuth = async () => {
    // Standard OAuth token verification requires client-side Google SDK integration.
    // Standard database-backed credentials should be used for core deployments.
    setError("Google Workspace Login requires the client-side Google SDK integration. Please use standard credentials below.");
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden px-4">
      {/* Radial Background Blob */}
      <div 
        className="absolute pointer-events-none" 
        style={{ 
          top: '-30%', 
          left: '-20%', 
          width: '140%', 
          height: '120%', 
          background: 'radial-gradient(circle, #112d55 0%, transparent 60%)', 
          opacity: 0.6, 
          zIndex: 0 
        }} 
      />

      {/* Dark Auth Card Container */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-[460px] bg-slate-900 rounded-[20px] shadow-[0_25px_50px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] p-8 md:p-10 border border-slate-800 z-10 flex flex-col">
        
        {/* Logo and Brand Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 mb-8 text-center">
          <div className="w-[54px] h-[54px] bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-[#60a5fa] rounded-[14px] grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 p-3 shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(13,110,253,0.25)]">
            <div className="bg-white rounded-[3px]" />
            <div className="bg-white rounded-[3px]" />
            <div className="bg-white rounded-[3px]" />
            <div className="bg-white rounded-[3px]" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-serif text-2xl text-white font-semibold tracking-wide m-0 mb-1">CSPC-E-ISSP</h1>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.5px] m-0">Unified Login</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h2 className="text-center font-serif text-[1.8rem] text-white font-medium mb-2">Welcome Back</h2>
        <p className="text-center text-slate-300 text-sm mb-6 leading-relaxed">
          Sign in to the Electronic ISSP platform using your CSPC Google Workspace account.
        </p>

        {/* Error Banner */}
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-950/50 border border-red-900 text-red-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md text-center">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Primary Auth Trigger: Google Mail */}
        <button 
          onClick={handleGoogleAuth}
          disabled={loading}
          type="button" 
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 w-full p-3 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-[10px] text-slate-200 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <svg className="w-5 h-5" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 48 48">

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { getDeptCatalog } from "../../../api/dept";
import { BookOpen, RefreshCw, Search, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

export default function CatalogViewer() {
  const [catalog, setCatalog] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getDeptCatalog();
      setCatalog(data);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to load reference catalog details:", e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  const filteredCatalog = catalog.filter(item => 
    item.display_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    item.item_key.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs max-w-5xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Standard Pricing & Reference Catalog</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Browse pre-approved specifications. Planners must select from this standard ledger to bypass validation locks.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchData}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Catalog</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex bg-slate-900 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 items-center gap-2.5 max-w-md">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Filter catalog items by key or name..."
          className="w-full bg-transparent outline-none border-none text-xs text-white"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Catalog Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Fetching standard catalog...</span>
            </div>
          ) : filteredCatalog.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                  <th className="p-3">Reference Item</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Category Classification</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Maximum Approved Unit Cost</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Verification Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850 text-slate-300">
                {filteredCatalog.map((item) => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{item.display_name}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5 select-all">{item.item_key}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 capitalize text-slate-400">
                      {item.category ? item.category.replace("_", " ") : "Uncategorized"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-200">
                      ₱{parseFloat(item.standard_unit_cost).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Pre-Approved
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">No catalog references match your search.</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { getBudgetSummary } from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  LayoutDashboard, 
  TrendingUp, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Landmark, 
  ShieldCheck,
  FileText
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DeptDashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [headroom, setHeadroom] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getBudgetSummary();
      setHeadroom(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to retrieve budget summary balances.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  if (loading && !headroom) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-slate-500 text-xs gap-2">
        <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span>Syncing budget headroom metrics...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Safe fallback defaults to prevent rendering exceptions on empty responses
  const subCeiling = headroom?.sub_ceiling || 0;
  const totalSpent = headroom?.total_spent || 0;
  
  const allocatedCapex = headroom?.allocated_capex || 0;
  const spentCapex = headroom?.current_spent_capex || 0;

  const allocatedMooe = headroom?.allocated_mooe || 0;
  const spentMooe = headroom?.current_spent_mooe || 0;

  const overallSpentPercent = subCeiling > 0 ? (totalSpent / subCeiling) * 100 : 0;
  const capexPercent = allocatedCapex > 0 ? (spentCapex / allocatedCapex) * 100 : 0;
  const mooePercent = allocatedMooe > 0 ? (spentMooe / allocatedMooe) * 100 : 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <LayoutDashboard className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-400" />
            <span>Departmental Budget Headroom Monitor</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Real-time tracking of active CapEx (Hardware) and MOOE (Software) spent balances against your allocated sub-ceiling.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchData}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition-all self-start"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Balances</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Budget Progress Metrics */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* Consolidated Sub-Ceiling Limit */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
            <Landmark className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
            <span>Consolidated Sub-Ceiling</span>
          </h3>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Total Spent:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">₱{totalSpent.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Allocated Limit:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">₱{subCeiling.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                className="bg-purple-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(overallSpentPercent, 100)}%` }} 
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
              Department is utilizing {overallSpentPercent.toFixed(1)}% of total allocated sub-ceiling.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CapEx Hardware Progress */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            <span>Capital Outlay (CapEx) Limit</span>
          </h3>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Approved Spent:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">₱{spentCapex.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">CapEx Limit:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">₱{allocatedCapex.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                className="bg-blue-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(capexPercent, 100)}%` }} 
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
              Hardware spending is at {capexPercent.toFixed(1)}% of the CapEx allotment.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* MOOE Software Progress */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>Operating Services (MOOE) Limit</span>
          </h3>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Approved Spent:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">₱{spentMooe.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">MOOE Limit:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">₱{allocatedMooe.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                className="bg-indigo-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(mooePercent, 100)}%` }} 
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
              Licensing spending is at {mooePercent.toFixed(1)}% of the MOOE allotment.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Pre-flight Dry-Run validation banners */}
      {headroom?.draft_dry_run && (
        <div className={`p-5 border rounded-xl flex items-start gap-4 leading-relaxed ${
          headroom.draft_dry_run.dry_run_validation_passed 
            ? "bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-800/80 text-emerald-300"
            : "bg-red-955/20 border-red-900/80 text-red-300"
        }`}>
          {headroom.draft_dry_run.dry_run_validation_passed ? (
            <>
              <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">Pre-Flight Dry Run Successful</h4>
                <p className="mt-1 text-slate-400 text-xs">
                  Your drafted hardware items and software subscriptions fit within your department's remaining headroom. Ready for submission.
                </p>

            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-red-400 shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">Budget Headroom Overrun Alert</h4>
                <p className="mt-1 text-slate-400 text-xs">
                  Submitting your active drafts would cause total expenditures to exceed your sub-ceiling allocations by <strong>₱{Math.abs((headroom.remaining_headroom || 0) - (headroom.draft_dry_run.total_drafted || 0)).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</strong>. Adjust drafted quantities or unit rates before attempting submission.
                </p>
