import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { getInventory, logExistingAsset } from '../../../api/dept';
import StatusPill from '../../../components/common/StatusPill';
import { Database, Plus, RefreshCw, Calendar, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

export default function InventoryManager() {
  const [inventory, setInventory] = useState([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('Functional');
  const [dateAcquired, setDateAcquired] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const fetchInventory = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getInventory()
      .then(setInventory)
      .catch((err) => console.error(err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchInventory();
  }, []);

  const handleAddAsset = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await logExistingAsset({ 
        item_name: name, 
        quantity: parseInt(qty, 10), 
        status: status,
        date_acquired: dateAcquired
      });
      setName('');
      setQty(1);
      setDateAcquired(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
      fetchInventory();
      alert('Asset logged inside database successfully (Annex A-5)');
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to log asset.');
    }
  };

  const isObsolete = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return false;
    const acqDate = new Date(dateString);
    const threeYearsAgo = new Date();
    threeYearsAgo.setFullYear(threeYearsAgo.getFullYear() - 3);
    return acqDate < threeYearsAgo;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      {/* Logger Box */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 p-6 space-y-4">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
          <span>Annex A-5 Baseline Inventory Logger</span>
        </h3>
        
        <form onSubmit={handleAddAsset} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 items-end">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Asset Name</label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              value={name} 
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-600" 
              placeholder="e.g. Office PC" 
              required 
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Quantity</label>
            <input 
              type="number" 
              min="1"
              value={qty} 
              onChange={(e) => setQty(e.target.value)} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all" 
              required 
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Acquisition Date</label>
            <input 
              type="date" 
              value={dateAcquired} 
              onChange={(e) => setDateAcquired(e.target.value)} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all font-mono cursor-pointer" 
              required 
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Current Status</label>
            <select 
              value={status} 
              onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none cursor-pointer focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all"
            >
              <option value="Functional" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Functional</option>
              <option value="Needs Repair" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Needs Repair</option>
              <option value="Condemned" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Condemned</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <button 
            type="submit" 
            className="p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Log Existing Asset</span>
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* Registry Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-955 border-b border-slate-800 font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex justify-between items-center">
          <span>Logged Asset Registry</span>
          {loading && <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-blue-500" />}
        </div>
        
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                <th className="p-4">Asset Details</th>
                <th className="p-4">Quantity</th>
                <th className="p-4">Acquisition Date</th>

                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { Key, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Shield, User } from "lucide-react";

export default function ProfileSettings() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState("");
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const handleUpdatePassword = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Validation Error: New password fields do not match.");
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 8) {
      setError("Validation Error: New password must be at least 8 characters long.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/auth/change-password`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          current_password: currentPassword,
          new_password: newPassword
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Password rotation rejected by the authorization system.");
      }

      setSuccess("Account password rotated successfully.");
      setCurrentPassword("");
      setNewPassword("");
      setConfirmPassword("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred during password modification.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-lg mx-auto text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      {/* Account Info Card */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
        <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-850 pb-2">
          <User className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          <span>User Profile Information</span>
        </h3>
        
        <div className="space-y-3 font-mono">
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-slate-850/60 pb-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Authorized Email:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-300 font-bold">{user?.email || "Unknown User"}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-slate-850/60 pb-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500">System Role Scope:</span>
            <span className="text-blue-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
              {user?.role === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? "MIS Administrator" : "Department Planner"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Department Identifier:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-300 font-bold">
              {user?.department_id ? `ID Code: ${user.department_id}` : "Unassociated Profile"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Security Credentials Card */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
        <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-850 pb-2">
          <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          <span>Rotate Account Password</span>
        </h3>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {success && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleUpdatePassword} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Current Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              value={currentPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setCurrentPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono tracking-widest outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">New Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              value={newPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Minimum 8 characters"
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono tracking-widest outline-none focus:border-amber-500 placeholder:text-slate-700"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Confirm New Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white font-mono tracking-widest outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full p-2.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-950 rounded-lg font-extrabold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
          >
            {submitting ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>Processing password rotation...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Save New Credentials</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/ActionInbox.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { getProposals, getSubscriptions } from "../../../api/dept";
import { Inbox, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, HelpCircle, History } from "lucide-react";

export default function ActionInbox() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  
  const [actionItems, setActionItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const fetchActionItems = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [proposals, subscriptions] = await Promise.all([
        getProposals(activeCycle),
        getSubscriptions(activeCycle)
      ]);

      const items = [];

      // Extract audit comments from CapEx Proposals
      proposals.forEach(p => {
        const comments = p.payload?.comments || [];
        comments.forEach(c => {
          items.push({
            ...c,
            parentId: p.id,
            parentName: p.item_name,
            parentType: "CapEx (Hardware)",
            parentStatus: p.status
          });
        });
      });

      // Extract audit comments from MOOE Subscriptions
      subscriptions.forEach(s => {
        const comments = s.payload?.comments || [];
        comments.forEach(c => {
          items.push({
            ...c,
            parentId: s.id,
            parentName: s.software_name,
            parentType: "MOOE (Software)",
            parentStatus: s.status
          });
        });
      });

      // Sort chronologically (newest entries first)
      items.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
      setActionItems(items);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load department action items.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchActionItems();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs max-w-4xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Inbox className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400" />
            <span>Administrative Remarks & Audit Log</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Read-only ledger of feedback, administrative corrections, and dynamic evaluation notes logged by the MIS Administrator.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchActionItems}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Refresh Logs</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action Items List */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-20 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-slate-500">
            <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Syncing remarks log...</span>
          </div>
        ) : actionItems.length > 0 ? (
          actionItems.map((item, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="p-5 rounded-xl border bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-850 pb-2">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono font-bold uppercase">
                    {item.parentType}
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm">{item.parentName}</h3>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-500/10 border border-slate-500/20 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded">
                    <History className="w-3 h-3" /> Logged Entry
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                  <span className="font-bold text-blue-400">{item.author_name} (Admin Operator)</span>
                  <span>{new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 font-mono text-[11px]">
                  {item.text}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-20 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <HelpCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-700" />
            <p className="italic">No remarks logged for your department.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

        getDeptCatalog()
      ]);
      setProposals(proposalsData);
      setCatalog(catalogData);
      if (catalogData.length > 0) {
        setItemSelect(catalogData[0].item_key);
        setUnitCost(String(catalogData[0].standard_unit_cost));
      } else {
        setItemSelect("other");
      }
      await fetchHeadroomData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to sync planning queue data.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  // Budget Headroom Live Warning Calculation (Gap 30)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!headroom) return;
    
    const currentUnitCost = parseFloat(unitCost) || 0.0;
    const currentTotalQty = Object.values(yearlyQuantities).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const projectedTotalCost = currentUnitCost * currentTotalQty;

    // Headroom check targets remaining CapEx balance
    const remaining = headroom.remaining_capex_headroom ?? headroom.remaining_headroom ?? 0.0;
    if (projectedTotalCost > remaining) {
      setWarning(
        `Budget Warning: This proposal will cost ₱${projectedTotalCost.toLocaleString(undefined, {
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2
        })}, which exceeds your remaining department headroom of ₱${remaining.toLocaleString(undefined, {
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2
        })}.`
      );
    } else {
      setWarning(null);
    }
  }, [unitCost, yearlyQuantities, headroom]);

  // Active Polling for Glacier Restore Progress (Gap 28)
  useEffect(() => {
    const activeRestorations = proposals.filter(p => p.is_restoring);
    if (activeRestorations.length === 0) return;

    const intervals = activeRestorations.map(p => {
      const intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${rawUrl}/api/dept/proposals/${p.id}/sync-metadata`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!data.is_restoring) {
              clearInterval(intervalId);
              fetchData(); // Trigger full refresh to update file download state
            } else {
              setProposals(prev => 
                prev.map(item => item.id === p.id ? { ...item, restore_progress: data.restore_progress } : item)
              );
            }
          }
        } catch (pollErr) {
          console.error("Error polling Glacier restoration status:", pollErr);
        }
      }, 10000); // Poll status every 10 seconds

      return { id: p.id, intervalId };
    });

    return () => {
      intervals.forEach(x => clearInterval(x.intervalId));
    };
  }, [proposals.filter(p => p.is_restoring).length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (itemSelect && itemSelect !== "other") {
      const selected = catalog.find(item => item.item_key === itemSelect);
      if (selected) {
        setUnitCost(String(selected.standard_unit_cost));
        setCustomSpec("");
      }
    } else if (itemSelect === "other") {
      setUnitCost("");
    }
  }, [itemSelect, catalog]);

  const handleCreateProposal = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    // Strict validation check for custom unlisted items
    if (itemSelect === "other") {
      if (!canvasFile || !supplierName.trim()) {
        setError("Compliance Violation: Posing a custom unlisted item requires a supplier name and a canvas quotation document.");
        return;
      }
    }
    
    setCreatingProposal(true);
    const parsedOffices = targetOffices ? [targetOffices] : [];
      
    const payload = {
      item_select: itemSelect,
      custom_specification: itemSelect === "other" ? customSpec : null,
      yearly_quantities: yearlyQuantities,
      unit_cost: parseFloat(unitCost) || 0.0,
      target_offices_json: parsedOffices,
      is_expansion: isExpansion,
      canvas_evidence_url: null
    };

    try {
      // 1. Log Proposal Draft
      const res = await createDraftProposal(payload);
      const proposalId = res.proposal_id;

      // 2. Upload and link file sequentially if "Other" is selected
      if (itemSelect === "other" && canvasFile) {
        await uploadCanvas(proposalId, supplierName.trim(), canvasFile);
      }

      setSuccess("Proposal draft created and canvas quotation linked successfully.");
      setCustomSpec("");
      setTargetOffices("");
      setIsExpansion(false);
      setSupplierName("");
      setCanvasFile(null);
      
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("inline-canvas-input");
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";

      if (planningYears && planningYears.length > 0) {
        const resetQty = {};
        planningYears.forEach(year => { resetQty[String(year)] = 0; });
        setYearlyQuantities(resetQty);
      }
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to create draft proposal.");
    } finally {
      setCreatingProposal(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStandaloneUpload = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!standaloneFile || !standaloneSupplier) {
      alert("Please provide both a supplier name and a valid canvas PDF file.");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setUploadingFile(true);
    try {
      await uploadCanvas(uploadProposalId, standaloneSupplier, standaloneFile);
      setSuccess("Canvas evidence document successfully uploaded.");
      setUploadProposalId(null);
      setStandaloneSupplier("");
      setStandaloneFile(null);
      
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("canvas-evidence-input");
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";

      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Upload operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setUploadingFile(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this proposal draft?")) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteProposal(id);
      setSuccess("Proposal draft successfully deleted.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to remove proposal.");
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (id) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await submitProposal(id);
      setSuccess("Proposal successfully transited to SUBMITTED status.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Submission process failed.");
    }
  };

  const handleMetadataSync = async (id) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await syncProposalMetadata(id);
      setSuccess(`Metadata synced successfully. S3 Class: ${res.storage_class}`);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Metadata sync failed.");
    }
  };

  const handleGlacierRestore = async (id) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await requestProposalRestore(id);
      setSuccess("AWS S3 Glacier cold-retrieval restoration initiated. Standard restore completes in 3-5 hours.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Cold retrieval initialization failed.");
    }
  };

  const openComments = async (proposal) => {
    setActiveCommentsProposal(proposal);
    setNewCommentText("");
    setRequiresAction(false);
    try {
      const data = await getComments(proposal.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handlePostComment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newCommentText.trim()) return;
    try {
      await postComment(activeCommentsProposal.id, {
        text: newCommentText.trim(),
        requires_department_action: requiresAction
      });
      setNewCommentText("");
      setRequiresAction(false);
      const data = await getComments(activeCommentsProposal.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || "Failed to post remark.");
    }
  };

  const handleResolveComment = async (commentId) => {
    try {
      await resolveComment(activeCommentsProposal.id, commentId);
      const data = await getComments(activeCommentsProposal.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || "Failed to resolve remark.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto select-none">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <FolderKanban className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Capital Outlay (CapEx) Hardware Proposals</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Log and manage your department's multi-year hardware requirements under the active compliance sub-ceiling limits.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchData}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Workspace</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-955/40 border border-emerald-900 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Creation Form Sidebar */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 h-fit space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Create CapEx Request</span>
          </h3>

          {/* Budget Headroom Stats Tracker Dashboard Block (Gap 30) */}
          {headroom && (
            <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 space-y-2 text-[11px]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[9px]">
                <Wallet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>CapEx Allotment Tracker</span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-slate-300">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[9px]">Allocated CapEx</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-100">
                    ₱{(headroom.allocated_capex ?? 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[9px]">Remaining Balance</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400">
                    ₱{(headroom.remaining_capex_headroom ?? headroom.remaining_headroom ?? 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleCreateProposal} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Standard Catalog Product
              </label>
              <select
                value={itemSelect}
                onChange={(e) => setItemSelect(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all cursor-pointer font-sans"
              >
                {catalog.map(item => (
                  <option key={item.item_key} value={item.item_key} className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100">
                    {item.display_name} (₱{Number(item.standard_unit_cost).toLocaleString()})
                  </option>
                ))}
                <option value="other" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100">-- Custom / Unlisted Equipment (Other) --</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {itemSelect === "other" && (
              <div className="space-y-4 p-3.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg animate-fadeIn">
                <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-extrabold text-blue-400 tracking-wider">
                  Mandatory Market Canvas Verification
                </span>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">
                    Detailed Specifications
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={customSpec}
                    onChange={(e) => setCustomSpec(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Brand, RAM, Storage, CPU specs"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">
                    Supplier Name
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={supplierName}
                    onChange={(e) => setSupplierName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Dell Philippines"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white font-sans"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">
                    Quotation Canvas Document (PDF Only)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="inline-canvas-input"
                    type="file"
                    required
                    accept="application/pdf"
                    onChange={(e) => setCanvasFile(e.target.files[0])}
                    className="w-full text-slate-300 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Unit Cost (PHP)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={itemSelect !== "other"}
                required
                value={unitCost}
                onChange={(e) => setUnitCost(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="0.00"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all disabled:opacity-50 font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
              <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">
                Multi-Year Quantity Targets
              </span>
              {planningYears.map(year => (
                <div key={year} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300 font-mono">FY {year}</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    max="10000"
                    required
                    value={yearlyQuantities[String(year)] || 0}
                    onChange={(e) => setYearlyQuantities({
                      ...yearlyQuantities,
                      [String(year)]: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                    })}
                    className="w-24 p-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-center text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Expansion Checkbox */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-slate-950/50 rounded-lg border border-slate-850">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                id="is_expansion"
                checked={isExpansion}
                onChange={(e) => setIsExpansion(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
              />
              <label htmlFor="is_expansion" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer select-none">
                Is this an expansion project?
              </label>
            </div>

            {/* Target Deployments Registry Selector Dropdown */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Target Deployment Office / Room {isExpansion && <span className="text-red-500">*</span>}
              </label>
              <select
                value={targetOffices}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetOffices(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600"
                required={isExpansion}
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Deployment Location --</option>
                {officesRegistry.map((off) => (
                  <option key={off.id} value={off.office_name}>
                    {off.office_name} ({off.division})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Dynamic Room Over Budget Headroom Warnings (Gap 30) */}
            {warning && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded animate-pulse leading-normal">
                {warning}
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={creatingProposal || !!warning}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{creatingProposal ? "Uploading & Creating..." : "Log Proposal Draft"}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Proposals List */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {uploadProposalId && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-xl border border-blue-900/50 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                  <span>Upload Canvas Quotation Evidence</span>
                </h4>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setUploadProposalId(null)}
                  className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  &times; Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
              <form onSubmit={handleStandaloneUpload} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 items-end text-xs">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">Supplier Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={standaloneSupplier}
                    onChange={(e) => setStandaloneSupplier(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. PC Express"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">Canvas PDF Document</label>
                  <input
                    id="canvas-evidence-input"
                    type="file"
                    required
                    accept="application/pdf"
                    onChange={(e) => setStandaloneFile(e.target.files[0])}
                    className="w-full text-slate-300 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={uploadingFile}
                  className="p-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded flex items-center justify-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{uploadingFile ? "Uploading..." : "Submit File"}</span>
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              Department Proposals Registry
            </h3>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              {loading ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-2 text-slate-500">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
                  <span className="text-xs">Loading active queue...</span>
                </div>
              ) : proposals.length > 0 ? (
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Proposed Item</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Multi-Year Quantities</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Unit Cost</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Quotation</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Status</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
                    {proposals.map(p => {
                      const isCustom = p.item_key === "other";
                      const filename = p.canvas_evidence_url ? p.canvas_evidence_url.split("/").pop() : null;
                      
                      return (
                        <React.Fragment key={p.id}>
                          <tr className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{p.item_name}</div>
                              {isCustom ? (
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-500 mt-0.5">Custom: {p.custom_specification}</div>
                              ) : (
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Standard Spec</div>
                              )}
                              {p.is_expansion && (
                                <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 mt-1 inline-block bg-blue-955/40 border border-blue-900 text-blue-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded">
                                  Expansion
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-300">Total: {p.total_qty} units</div>
                              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                                {planningYears.map(y => `${y}: ${p.yearly_quantities?.[String(y)] || 0}`).join(" | ")}
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-2 font-mono text-slate-200">
                              ₱{parseFloat(p.unit_cost).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                              {p.canvas_evidence_url ? (
                                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 items-start">
                                  <a 
                                    href={p.canvas_evidence_url} 
                                    target="_blank" 
                                    rel="noreferrer" 
                                    className="text-blue-400 underline font-semibold truncate max-w-[120px]"
                                  >
                                    {filename}
                                  </a>
                                  {p.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" ? (
                                    p.is_restoring ? (
                                      /* Active Time-Based S3 Glacier Progress Bar Indicator (Gap 28) */
                                      <div className="space-y-1 w-full max-w-[120px] pt-1">
                                        <div className="flex justify-between text-[8px] font-mono text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                                          <span>RESTORING</span>
                                          <span>{p.restore_progress || 50}%</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-850">
                                          <div 
                                            className="h-full bg-amber-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 animate-pulse" 
                                            style={{ width: `${p.restore_progress || 50}%` }} 
                                          />
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    ) : (
                                      <button 
                                        onClick={() => handleGlacierRestore(p.id)}
                                        className="text-[9px] text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 underline font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                                      >
                                        S3 Glacier Restore
                                      </button>
                                    )
                                  ) : (
                                    <button 
                                      onClick={() => handleMetadataSync(p.id)}
                                      title="Sync metadata class"
                                      className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer"
                                    >
                                      <RefreshCcw className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                      <span>Sync</span>
                                    </button>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <button 
                                  onClick={() => setUploadProposalId(p.id)}
                                  className="text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  <Upload className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>Upload Canvas</span>
                                </button>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                              <StatusPill status={p.status} />
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-right">
                              <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => setExpandedProposalId(expandedProposalId === p.id ? null : p.id)}
                                  className={`p-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                                    expandedProposalId === p.id ? "text-blue-400" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400"
                                  }`}
                                  title="Configure Deployments (Table IV.A)"
                                >
                                  <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => openComments(p)}
                                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  title="Comments thread"
                                >
                                  <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </button>
                                
                                {p.status === "Draft" || p.status === "Returned" ? (
                                  <>
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() => handleSubmit(p.id)}
                                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                      title="Submit Proposal"
                                    >
                                      <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() => handleDelete(p.id)}
                                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                      title="Delete Draft"
                                    >
                                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                    </button>
                                  </>
                                ) : (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 italic">Locked</span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                          
                          {/* Table IV.A Deployments Mapping Sub-Drawer (Gap 13) */}
                          {expandedProposalId === p.id && (
                            <tr className="bg-slate-950/30">
                              <td colSpan="6" className="p-4 border-t border-b border-slate-800/80">
                                <DeploymentsMapping 
                                  proposalId={p.id} 
                                  proposalName={p.item_name} 
                                  proposalTotalQty={p.total_qty} 
                                />
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          )}
                        </React.Fragment>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                  No active hardware proposals logged. Create a draft using the panel on the left.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {activeCommentsProposal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-955/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-xl flex flex-col h-[500px]">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-955/50 rounded-t-xl">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-sm">Discussions Thread</h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Proposal ID: {activeCommentsProposal.id}</p>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setActiveCommentsProposal(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-lg font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 font-sans text-xs">
              {comments.length > 0 ? (
                comments.map((comment) => (
                  <div key={comment.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
                      <span className="font-bold text-blue-400">{comment.author_name}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-500">{new Date(comment.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">{comment.text}</p>
                    
                    {comment.requires_department_action && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                        <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Requires Dept Action
                        </span>
                        {comment.is_resolved ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px]">
                            <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Resolved
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleResolveComment(comment.id)}
                            className="text-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Resolve Action
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500">
                  No discussion remarks logged yet. Pinned admin feedback will render here.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handlePostComment} className="p-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-955 rounded-b-xl flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={newCommentText}
                onChange={(e) => setNewCommentText(e.target.value)}

                type="submit"
                className="p-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded cursor-pointer"

// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/DeploymentsMapping.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { 
  Building2, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Inbox,
  ShieldAlert
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DeploymentsMapping({ proposalId, proposalName, proposalTotalQty = 0 }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [deployments, setDeployments] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    office_name: "",
    quantity: 1
  });

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const BASE_URL = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;

  const fetchDeploymentsList = async () => {
    if (!proposalId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/${proposalId}/deployments`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to load allocation mappings.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      setDeployments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to query Table IV.A deployment matrix.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token && proposalId) {
      fetchDeploymentsList();
    }
  }, [user, proposalId]);

  // Derived Calculations
  const allocatedQuantity = deployments.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.quantity, 0);
  const remainingQuantity = proposalTotalQty - allocatedQuantity;

  const validateForm = () => {
    if (!form.office_name.trim()) return "Target SUC Office name is required.";
    if (form.quantity < 1) return "Allocation quantity must be at least 1 unit.";
    if (form.quantity > remainingQuantity) {
      return `Allocation count (${form.quantity}) exceeds remaining unallocated quantity of ${remainingQuantity} units.`;
    }
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const validationError = validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/${proposalId}/deployments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          office_name: form.office_name.trim(),
          quantity: form.quantity
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json();
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to commit deployment allocation.");
      }

      setSuccess("Deployment allocation mapped successfully.");
      setForm({ office_name: "", quantity: remainingQuantity - form.quantity > 0 ? 1 : 0 });
      fetchDeploymentsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to write deployment allocation mapping.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently remove this deployment allocation mapping?")) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/api/dept/deployments/${id}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to delete deployment record.");
      }
      setSuccess("Deployment record removed successfully.");
      fetchDeploymentsList();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete deployment allocation mapping.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 p-5 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-100 select-none">
      
      {/* Title block */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-850 pb-3 flex justify-between items-center">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Table IV.A: Resource Deployment Matrix</span>
          </h3>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] mt-0.5 max-w-md">
            Deploy hardware quantities to SUC target offices. Total proposal allocation check active.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        {proposalTotalQty > 0 && (
          <div className="text-right font-mono text-[10px] space-y-0.5">
            <div className="text-slate-400">Total Requested: <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">{proposalTotalQty} units</span></div>
            <div className="text-slate-400">Unallocated: <span className={`font-bold ${remainingQuantity > 0 ? "text-amber-400" : "text-emerald-400"}`}>{remainingQuantity} units</span></div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Deployment Form */}
      {remainingQuantity > 0 ? (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 items-end sm:items-center bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-850">
          <div className="flex-1 w-full space-y-1">
            <label className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider block">Target SUC Office</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Dean's Office, Academic Support"
              value={form.office_name}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, office_name: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-xs text-slate-200 focus:outline-none"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="w-24 w-full sm:w-24 space-y-1">
            <label className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider block">Quantity</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="1"
              max={remainingQuantity}
              placeholder="Qty"
              value={form.quantity || ""}
              onChange={e => setForm({ ...form, quantity: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1 })}
              className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-xs text-center text-slate-200 font-mono font-bold"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto p-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="sm:hidden">Add Allocation</span>
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-900/40 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5 text-emerald-400">
          <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>Table IV.A Allocation complete. All {proposalTotalQty} proposed units have been mapped.</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Allocation List Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-950 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 overflow-hidden">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-8 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
            <span>Reading allocation mapping...</span>
          </div>
        ) : deployments.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-850">
            {deployments.map(d => (
              <div key={d.id} className="flex justify-between items-center p-3 hover:bg-slate-900/40 transition-colors">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{d.office_name}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-400 bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">
                    {d.quantity} units
                  </span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDelete(d.id)}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Delete Allocation"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <Inbox className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-600" />
            <span className="italic">No deployment mappings recorded yet.</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
