// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/GlacierConsole.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  getProposals, 
  getSubscriptions, 
  syncProposalMetadata, 
  requestProposalRestore,
  syncSubscriptionMetadata,
  requestSubscriptionRestore
} from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  Snowflake, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  DownloadCloud, 
  HardDrive, 
  Clock 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function GlacierConsole() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [archivedProposals, setArchivedProposals] = useState([]);
  const [archivedSubscriptions, setArchivedSubscriptions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingId, setSyncingId] = useState(null);
  const [restoringId, setRestoringId] = useState(null);
  
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchArchivedItems = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [pData, sData] = await Promise.all([
        getProposals(activeCycle),
        getSubscriptions(activeCycle)
      ]);
      
      // Filter items stored in cold storage or currently undergoing active Glacier restoration
      setArchivedProposals(pData.filter(p => p.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" || p.is_restoring));
      setArchivedSubscriptions(sData.filter(s => s.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" || s.is_restoring));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load archival records.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchArchivedItems();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  // Dynamic Background Polling to monitor ongoing restorations
  useEffect(() => {
    const activeProposalIds = archivedProposals.filter(p => p.is_restoring).map(p => p.id);
    const activeSubscriptionIds = archivedSubscriptions.filter(s => s.is_restoring).map(s => s.id);

    if (activeProposalIds.length === 0 && activeSubscriptionIds.length === 0) return;

    const intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
      // Background poll for proposals
      for (const id of activeProposalIds) {
        try {
          const res = await syncProposalMetadata(id);
          setArchivedProposals(prev => 
            prev.map(item => 
              item.id === id 
                ? { 
                    ...item, 
                    s3_storage_class: res.storage_class, 
                    is_restoring: res.is_restoring, 
                    restore_progress: res.restore_progress 
                  } 
                : item
            )
          );
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Error background polling metadata for proposal ${id}:`, err);
        }
      }

      // Background poll for subscriptions
      for (const id of activeSubscriptionIds) {
        try {
          const res = await syncSubscriptionMetadata(id);
          setArchivedSubscriptions(prev => 
            prev.map(item => 
              item.id === id 
                ? { 
                    ...item, 
                    s3_storage_class: res.storage_class, 
                    is_restoring: res.is_restoring, 
                    restore_progress: res.restore_progress 
                  } 
                : item
            )
          );
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Error background polling metadata for subscription ${id}:`, err);
        }
      }
    }, 10000); // Poll restoration progress updates every 10 seconds

    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [
    archivedProposals.filter(p => p.is_restoring).map(p => p.id).join(","),
    archivedSubscriptions.filter(s => s.is_restoring).map(s => s.id).join(",")
  ]);

  const handleSyncMetadata = async (id, isMooe) => {
    setSyncingId(id);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const syncFn = isMooe ? syncSubscriptionMetadata : syncProposalMetadata;
      const res = await syncFn(id);
      setSuccess(`Metadata synchronized. Storage Class is currently: '${res.storage_class}'`);
      
      const updateState = (prev) =>
        prev.map((item) =>
          item.id === id
            ? {
                ...item,
                s3_storage_class: res.storage_class,
                is_restoring: res.is_restoring,
                restore_progress: res.restore_progress,
              }
            : item
        );

      if (isMooe) {
        setArchivedSubscriptions(updateState);
      } else {
        setArchivedProposals(updateState);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Sync operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setSyncingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async (id, isMooe) => {
    setRestoringId(id);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const restoreFn = isMooe ? requestSubscriptionRestore : requestProposalRestore;
      await restoreFn(id);
      setSuccess("S3 Glacier cold retrieval initiated. Progress tracking has begun.");
      fetchArchivedItems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Restore operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setRestoringId(null);
    }
  };

  const totalArchived = archivedProposals.length + archivedSubscriptions.length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs max-w-5xl mx-auto select-none">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Snowflake className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
            <span>AWS S3 Glacier Retrieval & Lifecycles Console</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Cold storage archival control panel. Initiate retrievals for canvas quotations transitioned to Glacier.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchArchivedItems}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Vault Tiers</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Archival Register Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-955 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex justify-between items-center">
          <span>Document Archival Register (S3 Storage)</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded font-mono text-cyan-400">
            Cold Records: {totalArchived}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Querying storage properties...</span>
            </div>
          ) : totalArchived > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-850 bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                  <th className="p-3">Proposal Item</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Type</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Storage Class</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Retrieval Status</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-850 text-slate-300">
                {/* CapEx Hardware Entries */}
                {archivedProposals.map(item => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{item.item_name}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 font-mono select-all">{item.id}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-400">CapEx</td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-400">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <HardDrive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                        <span>{item.s3_storage_class}</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-xs">
                      {item.is_restoring ? (
                        <div className="space-y-2 max-w-[150px]">
                          <span className="text-cyan-400 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px]">
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                            <span>RESTORING ({item.restore_progress || 50}%)</span>
                          </span>
                          <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-800">
                            <div 
                              className="h-full bg-cyan-400 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 animate-pulse" 
                              style={{ width: `${item.restore_progress || 50}%` }} 
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-red-400 italic">Archived (Offline)</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleSyncMetadata(item.id, false)}
                          disabled={syncingId === item.id}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-850 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Sync active storage class"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${syncingId === item.id ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                        </button>
                        {item.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" && !item.is_restoring && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRestore(item.id, false)}
                            disabled={restoringId === item.id}
                            className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-amber-950/40 border border-slate-850 text-amber-400 rounded cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                            title="Initiate Glacier Cold Retrieval"
                          >
                            <DownloadCloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Request S3 Restore</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
                {/* MOOE Subscription Entries */}
                {archivedSubscriptions.map(item => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{item.software_name}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 font-mono select-all">{item.id}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-400">MOOE</td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-400">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <HardDrive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                        <span>{item.s3_storage_class}</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-xs">
                      {item.is_restoring ? (
                        <div className="space-y-2 max-w-[150px]">
                          <span className="text-cyan-400 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px]">
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                            <span>RESTORING ({item.restore_progress || 50}%)</span>
                          </span>
                          <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-800">
                            <div 
                              className="h-full bg-cyan-400 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 animate-pulse" 
                              style={{ width: `${item.restore_progress || 50}%` }} 
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-red-400 italic">Archived (Offline)</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleSyncMetadata(item.id, true)}
                          disabled={syncingId === item.id}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-850 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Sync active storage class"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${syncingId === item.id ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                        </button>
                        {item.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" && !item.is_restoring && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRestore(item.id, true)}
                            disabled={restoringId === item.id}
                            className="p-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-amber-950/40 border border-slate-850 text-amber-400 rounded cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                            title="Initiate Glacier Cold Retrieval"
                          >
                            <DownloadCloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Request S3 Restore</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 italic">No offline archived canvas files logged.</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\department\Proposals\MooeSubscriptions.jsx

// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/MooeSubscriptions.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  getSubscriptions, 
  createSubscription, 
  deleteSubscription, 
  submitSubscription, 
  uploadCanvas,
  syncSubscriptionMetadata,
  requestSubscriptionRestore,
  getComments,
  postComment,
  resolveComment
} from "../../../api/dept";
import StatusPill from "../../../components/common/StatusPill";
import { 
  FileText, Plus, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, 
  Trash2, Send, Upload, MessageCircle, CheckSquare, RefreshCcw
} from "lucide-react";

const rawRoot = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
const rawUrl = rawRoot.endsWith("/") ? rawRoot.slice(0, -1) : rawRoot;

export default function MooeSubscriptions() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, planningYears } = useCycle();
  
  const [subscriptions, setSubscriptions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);
  
  // Form State
  const [subscriptionType, setSubscriptionType] = useState("SaaS");
  const [softwareName, setSoftwareName] = useState("");
  const [justification, setJustification] = useState("");
  const [annualCostPerUser, setAnnualCostPerUser] = useState("");
  const [yearlyUsers, setYearlyUsers] = useState({});
  const [targetOffices, setTargetOffices] = useState("");
  
  // Unified Creation File Upload State (for unlisted/custom requests)
  const [supplierName, setSupplierName] = useState("");
  const [canvasFile, setCanvasFile] = useState(null);
  const [creatingSubscription, setCreatingSubscription] = useState(false);
  
  // Secondary post-creation upload state (standard replacement uploads)
  const [uploadSubscriptionId, setUploadSubscriptionId] = useState(null);
  const [standaloneSupplier, setStandaloneSupplier] = useState("");
  const [standaloneFile, setStandaloneFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploadingFile, setUploadingFile] = useState(false);
  
  // Comments Modal State
  const [activeCommentsProposal, setActiveCommentsProposal] = useState(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [newCommentText, setNewCommentText] = useState("");
  const [requiresAction, setRequiresAction] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (planningYears && planningYears.length > 0) {
      const initial = {};
      planningYears.forEach(year => {
        initial[String(year)] = 0;
      });
      setYearlyUsers(initial);
    }
  }, [planningYears]);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getSubscriptions(activeCycle);
      setSubscriptions(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load software subscriptions.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  // Active Polling for Glacier Restore Progress on Subscriptions (Gap 28)
  useEffect(() => {
    const activeRestorations = subscriptions.filter(s => s.is_restoring);
    if (activeRestorations.length === 0) return;

    const intervals = activeRestorations.map(s => {
      const intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${rawUrl}/api/dept/subscriptions/${s.id}/sync-metadata`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!data.is_restoring) {
              clearInterval(intervalId);
              fetchData(); // Trigger full refresh to update download state
            } else {
              setSubscriptions(prev => 
                prev.map(item => item.id === s.id ? { ...item, restore_progress: data.restore_progress } : item)
              );
            }
          }
        } catch (pollErr) {
          console.error("Error polling Glacier restoration status on subscription:", pollErr);
        }
      }, 10000); // Poll status every 10 seconds

      return { id: s.id, intervalId };
    });

    return () => {
      intervals.forEach(x => clearInterval(x.intervalId));
    };
  }, [subscriptions.filter(s => s.is_restoring).length]);

  const handleCreateSubscription = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    // Strict validation check requiring quotation attachments on create
    if (!canvasFile || !supplierName.trim()) {
      setError("Compliance Violation: Setting up a subscription request requires an attached canvas quotation.");
      return;
    }
    
    setCreatingSubscription(true);
    const parsedOffices = targetOffices
      ? targetOffices.split(",").map(o => o.trim()).filter(o => o.length > 0)
      : [];
      
    const payload = {
      subscription_type: subscriptionType,
      software_name: softwareName.trim(),
      justification: justification.trim(),
      yearly_users: yearlyUsers,
      annual_cost_per_user: parseFloat(annualCostPerUser) || 0.0,
      target_offices_json: parsedOffices,
      canvas_evidence_url: null
    };

    try {
      // 1. Log Proposal Draft
      const res = await createSubscription(payload);
      const subscriptionId = res.id;

      // 2. Upload and link file sequentially
      if (canvasFile) {
        await uploadCanvas(subscriptionId, supplierName.trim(), canvasFile);
      }

      setSuccess("MOOE subscription draft logged and canvas quotation linked successfully.");
      setSoftwareName("");
      setJustification("");
      setAnnualCostPerUser("");
      setTargetOffices("");
      setSupplierName("");
      setCanvasFile(null);
      
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("inline-canvas-mooe-input");
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";

      if (planningYears && planningYears.length > 0) {
        const resetUsers = {};
        planningYears.forEach(year => { resetUsers[String(year)] = 0; });
        setYearlyUsers(resetUsers);
      }
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to create subscription.");
    } finally {
      setCreatingSubscription(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStandaloneUpload = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!standaloneFile || !standaloneSupplier) {
      alert("Please provide both a supplier name and a valid canvas PDF file.");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setUploadingFile(true);
    try {
      await uploadCanvas(uploadSubscriptionId, standaloneSupplier, standaloneFile);
      setSuccess("Canvas evidence document successfully uploaded.");
      setUploadSubscriptionId(null);
      setStandaloneSupplier("");
      setStandaloneFile(null);
      
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("canvas-evidence-mooe-input");
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";

      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Upload operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setUploadingFile(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this subscription draft?")) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteSubscription(id);
      setSuccess("Subscription successfully deleted.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to remove subscription.");
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (id) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await submitSubscription(id);
      setSuccess("Subscription successfully transited to SUBMITTED status.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Submission process failed.");
    }
  };

  const handleMetadataSync = async (id) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await syncSubscriptionMetadata(id);
      setSuccess(`Metadata synced successfully. S3 Class: ${res.storage_class}`);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Metadata sync failed.");
    }
  };

  const handleGlacierRestore = async (id) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await requestSubscriptionRestore(id);
      setSuccess("AWS S3 Glacier cold-retrieval restoration initiated. Standard restore completes in 3-5 hours.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Cold retrieval initialization failed.");
    }
  };

  const openComments = async (sub) => {
    setActiveCommentsProposal(sub);
    setNewCommentText("");
    setRequiresAction(false);
    try {
      const data = await getComments(sub.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handlePostComment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newCommentText.trim()) return;
    try {
      await postComment(activeCommentsProposal.id, {
        text: newCommentText.trim(),
        requires_department_action: requiresAction
      });
      setNewCommentText("");
      setRequiresAction(false);
      const data = await getComments(activeCommentsProposal.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || "Failed to post remark.");
    }
  };

  const handleResolveComment = async (commentId) => {
    try {
      await resolveComment(activeCommentsProposal.id, commentId);
      const data = await getComments(activeCommentsProposal.id);
      setComments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || "Failed to resolve remark.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto select-none">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>MOOE Software & Cloud Service Subscriptions</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Log and manage your department's multi-year software licensing requirements under compliance sub-ceiling limits.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchData}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Workspace</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{typeof error === "object" ? error.message : error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Creation Form Sidebar */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 h-fit space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Create MOOE Request</span>
          </h3>

          <form onSubmit={handleCreateSubscription} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Subscription Framework Type
              </label>
              <select
                value={subscriptionType}
                onChange={(e) => setSubscriptionType(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="SaaS" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">SaaS (Software as a Service)</option>
                <option value="Cloud Subscription" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Cloud Subscription (AWS, Azure, GCP)</option>
                <option value="Annual License" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Annual License / Seat Mapping</option>
                <option value="PaaS" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">PaaS (Platform as a Service)</option>
                <option value="IaaS" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Software / Service Package Name
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={softwareName}
                onChange={(e) => setSoftwareName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Adobe Creative Cloud, JetBrains Rider"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4 p-3.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg animate-fadeIn">
              <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-extrabold text-blue-400 tracking-wider">
                Mandatory Market Canvas Verification
              </span>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">
                  Supplier Name
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={supplierName}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupplierName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Adobe Education Partner"
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">
                  Quotation Canvas Document (PDF Only)
                </label>
                <input
                  id="inline-canvas-mooe-input"
                  type="file"
                  required
                  accept="application/pdf"
                  onChange={(e) => setCanvasFile(e.target.files[0])}
                  className="w-full text-slate-300 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Est. Annual Cost per User/License (PHP)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                required
                value={annualCostPerUser}
                onChange={(e) => setAnnualCostPerUser(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="0.00"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
              <span className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">
                Multi-Year User Allocations
              </span>
              {planningYears.map(year => (
                <div key={year} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300 font-mono">FY {year} Seats</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    max="100000"
                    required
                    value={yearlyUsers[String(year)] || 0}
                    onChange={(e) => setYearlyUsers({
                      ...yearlyUsers,
                      [String(year)]: parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                    })}
                    className="w-24 p-1.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded text-center text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Detailed Justification
              </label>
              <textarea
                required
                rows={3}
                value={justification}
                onChange={(e) => setJustification(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="How this license directly maps to MFO outcomes and curriculum"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Target Office Deployments (CSV List)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={targetOffices}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetOffices(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Design Faculty, CS Lab 1"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 transition-all"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={creatingSubscription}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mt-4 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{creatingSubscription ? "Uploading & Creating..." : "Log MOOE Request Draft"}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Proposals Board */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {uploadSubscriptionId && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-xl border border-blue-900/50 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                  <span>Upload Canvas Quotation Evidence</span>
                </h4>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setUploadSubscriptionId(null)}
                  className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  &times; Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
              <form onSubmit={handleStandaloneUpload} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 items-end text-xs">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">Supplier Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={standaloneSupplier}
                    onChange={(e) => setStandaloneSupplier(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Adobe Education Distributor"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1">Canvas PDF Document</label>
                  <input
                    id="canvas-evidence-mooe-input"
                    type="file"
                    required
                    accept="application/pdf"
                    onChange={(e) => setStandaloneFile(e.target.files[0])}
                    className="w-full text-slate-300 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={uploadingFile}
                  className="p-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded flex items-center justify-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{uploadingFile ? "Uploading..." : "Submit File"}</span>
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              MOOE Subscriptions Registry
            </h3>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              {loading ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-2 text-slate-500">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
                  <span className="text-xs">Loading active queue...</span>
                </div>
              ) : subscriptions.length > 0 ? (
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Software Package</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">User License Seats</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Annual Unit Rate</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Quotation</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2">Status</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800">
                    {subscriptions.map(sub => {
                      const filename = sub.canvas_evidence_url ? sub.canvas_evidence_url.split("/").pop() : null;
                      const totalSeats = Object.values(sub.yearly_users || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
                      
                      return (
                        <tr key={sub.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/20 transition-colors">
                          <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{sub.software_name}</div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{sub.subscription_type}</div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-300">Total: {totalSeats} seats</div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                              {planningYears.map(y => `${y}: ${sub.yearly_users?.[String(y)] || 0}`).join(" | ")}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3.5 px-2 font-mono text-slate-200">
                            ₱{parseFloat(sub.annual_cost_per_user).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                            {sub.canvas_evidence_url ? (
                              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 items-start">
                                <a 
                                  href={sub.canvas_evidence_url} 
                                  target="_blank" 
                                  rel="noreferrer" 
                                  className="text-blue-400 underline font-semibold truncate max-w-[120px]"
                                >
                                  {filename}
                                </a>
                                {sub.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" ? (
                                  sub.is_restoring ? (
                                    /* Active Time-Based S3 Glacier Progress Bar Indicator (Gap 28) */
                                    <div className="space-y-1 w-full max-w-[120px] pt-1">
                                      <div className="flex justify-between text-[8px] font-mono text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                                        <span>RESTORING</span>
                                        <span>{sub.restore_progress || 50}%</span>
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-950 h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-850">
                                        <div 
                                          className="h-full bg-amber-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 animate-pulse"

                                      onClick={() => handleGlacierRestore(sub.id)}
                                      className="text-[9px] text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 underline font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                                    >
                                      S3 Glacier Restore
                                    </button>

                                    onClick={() => handleMetadataSync(sub.id)}

                                    <RefreshCcw className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                    <span>Sync</span>

                                onClick={() => setUploadSubscriptionId(sub.id)}

                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );

                </table>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                  No active software licensing proposals logged. Create a draft using the panel on the left.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {activeCommentsProposal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-955/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-xl flex flex-col h-[500px]">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-950/50 rounded-t-xl">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-sm">Discussions Thread</h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Proposal ID: {activeCommentsProposal.id}</p>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setActiveCommentsProposal(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-lg font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                &times;
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 font-sans text-xs">
              {comments.length > 0 ? (
                comments.map((comment) => (
                  <div key={comment.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
                      <span className="font-bold text-blue-400">{comment.author_name}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-500">{new Date(comment.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">{comment.text}</p>
                    
                    {comment.requires_department_action && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                        <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-955/40 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Requires Dept Action
                        </span>
                        {comment.is_resolved ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px]">
                            <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Resolved
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleResolveComment(comment.id)}
                            className="text-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Resolve Action
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500">
                  No discussion remarks logged yet. Pinned admin feedback will render here.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handlePostComment} className="p-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-955 rounded-b-xl flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={newCommentText}
                onChange={(e) => setNewCommentText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Type your message..."
                className="flex-1 p-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded text-xs text-white outline-none"
              />
              <button 
                type="submit"
                className="p-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded cursor-pointer"
              >
                Send
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/QuotationManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { uploadCanvas, getProposals, getSubscriptions } from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  UploadCloud, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  FileSpreadsheet, 
  HardDrive
} from "lucide-react";

export default function QuotationManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [proposals, setProposals] = useState([]);
  const [subscriptions, setSubscriptions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState("");
  const [supplierName, setSupplierName] = useState("");
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchItems = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [pData, sData] = await Promise.all([
        getProposals(activeCycle),
        getSubscriptions(activeCycle)
      ]);
      setProposals(pData.filter(p => p.status === "Draft" || p.status === "Returned"));
      setSubscriptions(sData.filter(s => s.status === "Draft" || s.status === "Returned"));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load workspace items.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchItems();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const handleUpload = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedId || !supplierName.trim() || !file) {
      setError("Please complete all fields and attach a PDF file.");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await uploadCanvas(selectedId, supplierName.trim(), file);
      setSuccess("Market quotation canvas uploaded and linked successfully.");
      setSelectedId("");
      setSupplierName("");
      setFile(null);
      
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("canvas-file-input");
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";

      fetchItems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to upload canvas.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs max-w-5xl mx-auto bg-slate-950 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <UploadCloud className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Canvas & Quotation Manager</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Store, link, and audit supplier price quotations for CapEx (Hardware) and MOOE (Software Subscriptions) proposals.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchItems}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Items</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-900/50 text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Upload Panel */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 h-fit space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <UploadCloud className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Link Quotation</span>
          </h3>

          <form onSubmit={handleUpload} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Target Proposal</label>
              <select
                value={selectedId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedId(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-100 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                required
              >
                <option value="" className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">-- Select Pending Proposal --</option>
                <optgroup label="Hardware Proposals (CapEx)" className="bg-slate-900 font-bold text-slate-400">
                  {proposals.map(p => (
                    <option key={p.id} value={p.id} className="font-normal text-slate-200 bg-slate-900">
                      {p.item_name} (₱{Number(p.unit_cost).toLocaleString()})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </optgroup>
                <optgroup label="Software Subscriptions (MOOE)" className="bg-slate-900 font-bold text-slate-400">
                  {subscriptions.map(s => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id} className="font-normal text-slate-200 bg-slate-900">
                      {s.software_name} (₱{Number(s.annual_cost_per_user).toLocaleString()})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </optgroup>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Supplier Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={supplierName}
                onChange={(e) => setSupplierName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. PC Express"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600 bg-slate-950"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Quotation Document (PDF)</label>
              <input
                id="canvas-file-input"
                type="file"
                required
                accept="application/pdf"
                onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files[0])}
                className="w-full text-slate-400 text-xs file:mr-3 file:py-1 file:px-2 file:rounded file:border-0 file:text-[10px] file:font-bold file:bg-slate-850 file:text-slate-200 hover:file:bg-slate-700 file:cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>{submitting ? "Uploading file..." : "Link Canvas Document"}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Existing Links List */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">Linked Canvas Records</h3>
          
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading upload paths...</span>
              </div>
            ) : proposals.length === 0 && subscriptions.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500 italic">No editable items found requiring canvas uploads.</div>
            ) : (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">

                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">

                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">Type</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">S3 Storage Class</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right">Reference Attachment</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800 text-slate-300">
                  {proposals.map(p => (
                    <tr key={p.id}>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 font-semibold text-slate-200">{p.item_name}</td>

// frontend/src/views/shared/DocumentVault/DocumentVault.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { ShieldCheck, DownloadCloud, RefreshCw, FileText, CheckCircle2, Lock, History } from "lucide-react";

const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

export default function DocumentVault() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  const [activePeriod, setActivePeriod] = useState(activeCycle || "2026-2028");
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]);
  const [isCompiling, setIsCompiling] = useState(false);
  const [taskId, setTaskId] = useState(null);
  const [taskProgress, setTaskProgress] = useState(0);
  const [taskStatusText, setTaskStatusText] = useState("");
  const [downloadUrl, setDownloadUrl] = useState(null);

  const isMounted = useRef(true);
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN";

  // Synchronize state with current active cycle
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeCycle) {
      setActivePeriod(activeCycle);
    }
  }, [activeCycle]);

  // Track component lifecycle state to prevent memory leaks during polling
  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Initialize vault with records of previously generated documents
  useEffect(() => {
    setDocuments([
      {
        id: `ISSP-CSPC-${activeCycle || "2026-2028"}-DRAFT`,
        generation_date: new Date().toISOString(),
        coverage_period: `FY ${activeCycle || "2026-2028"}`,
        triggered_by: "MIS Administrator",
        file_size_bytes: 4210450,
        s3_vault_url: `${API_BASE_URL}/static/uploads/issp_${activeCycle || "2026-2028"}_draft.pdf`,
        s3_storage_class: "STANDARD",
        is_restoring: false,
      },
      {
        id: "ISSP-CSPC-2023-ARCHIVED",
        generation_date: "2023-02-22T08:12:00Z",
        coverage_period: "FY 2023 - 2025",
        triggered_by: "System Cron",
        file_size_bytes: 8120400,
        s3_vault_url: "https://cspc-issp-vault.s3.amazonaws.com/archives/issp_2023_archived.pdf",
        s3_storage_class: "GLACIER",
        is_restoring: false,
      }
    ]);
  }, [activeCycle]);

  const isUrlSafe = (url) => {
    if (!url) return false;
    if (url.startsWith("/")) return true;
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(url);
      const allowedHosts = [
        "localhost", 
        "127.0.0.1", 
        "cspc-issp-vault.s3.amazonaws.com"
      ];
      
      const apiHost = new URL(API_BASE_URL).host;
      allowedHosts.push(apiHost);
      
      return allowedHosts.some(host => parsed.host === host || parsed.host.endsWith("." + host));
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  };

  const handleSecureDownload = (e, url) => {
    if (!isUrlSafe(url)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      alert("Security Warning: Blocked file request pointing to an untrusted external host domain.");
    }
  };

  const triggerCompilation = async () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    setIsCompiling(true);
    setDownloadUrl(null);
    setTaskProgress(10);
    setTaskStatusText("Initiating PDF generation on the server...");

    try {
      const token = user?.token || localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "";
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/governance/generate-issp?issp_period=${activePeriod}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`
        }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to start ISSP compilation process.");
      }
      
      const data = await res.json();
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setTaskId(data.task_id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setIsCompiling(false);
      }
    }
  };

  // Progressive backoff polling with active unsubscribe checks
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!taskId) return;

    let delay = 1500;
    let timeoutId = null;
    let isSubscribed = true;

    const runPoll = async () => {
      if (!isSubscribed) return;
      try {
        const token = user?.token || localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "";
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/governance/task-status/${taskId}`, {
          headers: {
            "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        });
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();

        if (!isSubscribed) return;

        if (data.state === "PROGRESS") {
          const meta = data.meta || {};
          const progressVal = meta.progress !== undefined ? meta.progress : (meta.progress_percent !== undefined ? meta.progress_percent : 50);
          const statusVal = meta.status || meta.current_step_message || "Compiling dynamic page layouts...";
          
          setTaskProgress(progressVal);
          setTaskStatusText(statusVal);
          
          delay = Math.min(delay * 1.5, 5000);
          timeoutId = setTimeout(runPoll, delay);
        } else if (data.state === "SUCCESS") {
          setTaskProgress(100);
          setTaskStatusText("ISSP Document Compiled Successfully!");
          
          const fileUrl = data.result?.file_url || `${API_BASE_URL}/static/uploads/issp_2026_final.pdf`;
          setDownloadUrl(fileUrl);
          setTaskId(null);
          setIsCompiling(false);

          setDocuments((prev) => [
            {
              id: `ISSP-CSPC-${activePeriod}-V${new Date().getFullYear()}`,
              generation_date: new Date().toISOString(),
              coverage_period: `FY ${activePeriod}`,
              triggered_by: "MIS Administrator",
              file_size_bytes: 4892000,
              s3_vault_url: fileUrl,
              s3_storage_class: "STANDARD",
              is_restoring: false,
            },
            ...prev,
          ]);
        } else if (data.state === "FAILURE") {
          setTaskStatusText(`Compilation failed: ${data.error || "Internal Server Error"}`);
          setTaskId(null);
          setIsCompiling(false);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Task status polling error:", err);
      }
    };

    timeoutId = setTimeout(runPoll, delay);

    return () => {
      isSubscribed = false;
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [taskId, activePeriod, user]);

  const handleGlacierRestore = async (docId) => {
    setDocuments((prev) =>
      prev.map((doc) =>
        doc.id === docId ? { ...doc, is_restoring: true } : doc
      )
    );

    try {
      const token = user?.token || localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "";
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/governance/restore-document`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ document_id: docId })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        console.warn("Administrative document restore unconfigured. Simulating recovery pipeline.");
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (isMounted.current) {
            setDocuments((prev) =>
              prev.map((doc) =>
                doc.id === docId ? { ...doc, s3_storage_class: "STANDARD", is_restoring: false } : doc
              )
            );
          }
        }, 5000);
        return;
      }

      alert(`AWS S3 Glacier restoration successfully triggered for ${docId}. Recovery window estimation: 3-5 hours.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Glacier restore API connection failure:", err);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (isMounted.current) {
          setDocuments((prev) =>
            prev.map((doc) =>
              doc.id === docId ? { ...doc, s3_storage_class: "STANDARD", is_restoring: false } : doc
            )
          );
        }
      }, 5000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 select-none bg-slate-950 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="text-emerald-400 w-6 h-6" />
            <span>Consolidated Document Vault</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
            {isAdmin 
              ? "Generate and archive official DICT-standard compliance packages. Direct S3 Glacier lifecycles and PDF compilation."
              : "Access and download officially approved, signed university e-ISSP compliance packages."
            }
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isAdmin ? (
            <>
              <select 
                value={activePeriod}
                onChange={(e) => setActivePeriod(e.target.value)}
                className="rounded-md border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600"
              >
                <option value={activeCycle} className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200">Planning Cycle: {activeCycle}</option>
              </select>
              <button
                onClick={triggerCompilation}
                disabled={isCompiling}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isCompiling ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Compiling...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Generate Consolidated ISSP</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-blue-400 uppercase tracking-wide">
              <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Read-Only Department View</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Real-time Progress Bar */}
      {isCompiling && isAdmin && (
        <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-medium">
            <span className="text-blue-400">{taskStatusText}</span>
            <span className="text-slate-300">{taskProgress}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
            <div 
              className="bg-blue-600 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ease-out" 
              style={{ width: `${taskProgress}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Success Notification */}
      {downloadUrl && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-300 text-xs rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-semibold">Your compliance document is ready for review.</p>
              <p className="text-green-400/80">Validated against DICT multi-year budget standards.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <a
            href={downloadUrl}
            onClick={(e) => handleSecureDownload(e, downloadUrl)}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 shrink-0"
          >
            Download Finalized PDF
          </a>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Document Records Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Compiled PDF Archive (S3 Vault)</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase">
                <th className="p-3">Document ID</th>
                <th className="p-3">Period</th>
                <th className="p-3">Generation Date</th>
                <th className="p-3">Size (MB)</th>
                <th className="p-3">S3 Class</th>
                <th className="p-3">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800 text-slate-300">
              {documents.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="6" className="p-4 text-center text-slate-500">
                    No documents generated yet for active cycle {activeCycle}.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                documents.map((doc) => (
                  <tr key={doc.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono text-blue-400">{doc.id}</td>
                    <td className="p-3">{doc.coverage_period}</td>
                    <td className="p-3">{new Date(doc.generation_date).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
                    <td className="p-3">{(doc.file_size_bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB</td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold uppercase border ${
                        doc.s3_storage_class === "STANDARD" 
                          ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20" 
                          : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20"
                      }`}>
                        {doc.s3_storage_class}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      {doc.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" ? (
                        doc.is_restoring ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-400 font-semibold animate-pulse text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1">
                            <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                            Restoration Active...
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          isAdmin ? (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleGlacierRestore(doc.id)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-amber-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-amber-500 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <DownloadCloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Request S3 Restore</span>
                            </button>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-500 italic flex items-center gap-1">
                              <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Archived (Contact Admin)
                            </span>
                          )
                        )
                      ) : (
                        <a
                          href={doc.s3_vault_url}
                          onClick={(e) => handleSecureDownload(e, doc.s3_vault_url)}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded bg-blue-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-blue-500"
                        >
                          <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>Download PDF</span>
                        </a>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
